```{r}
cat("D2. Range preservation check (PMM variables)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: PMM imputes by matching observed donors, so imputed\n")
cat("           values MUST lie within the observed range. Values\n")
cat("           outside this range indicate a bug in the PMM donor\n")
cat("           selection (should not occur under correct setup).\n\n")

pmm_vars      <- names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method == "pmm"])
pmm_vars      <- pmm_vars[pmm_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
# ── Only check truly numeric variables — Fix B switches some ordered factors
# to PMM, but they remain factor class in df_imp. min/max are not meaningful
# for factors and will error. Restrict to is.numeric() only.
pmm_vars      <- pmm_vars[sapply(df_imp[pmm_vars], is.numeric)]
range_fails   <- character()
range_summary <- data.frame()

for(var in pmm_vars) {
  if(!var %in% names(df_imp)) next
  obs_vals <- df_imp[[var]][!is.na(df_imp[[var]])]
  if(length(obs_vals) == 0) next
  obs_min <- min(obs_vals); obs_max <- max(obs_vals)

  all_imp_vals <- unlist(lapply(all_imp_list, function(d) {
    orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
    if(sum(orig_na) == 0) return(NULL)
    d[[var]][orig_na]
  }))

  if(length(all_imp_vals) == 0) next

  imp_min <- min(all_imp_vals); imp_max <- max(all_imp_vals)
  out_of_range <- sum(all_imp_vals < obs_min | all_imp_vals > obs_max)

  range_summary <- rbind(range_summary, data.frame(
    variable      = var,
    obs_min       = obs_min,
    obs_max       = obs_max,
    imp_min       = imp_min,
    imp_max       = imp_max,
    n_out_of_range = out_of_range
  ))

  if(out_of_range > 0)
    range_fails <- c(range_fails,
                     sprintf("%-35s obs [%.1f, %.1f]  imp [%.1f, %.1f]  n_OOB=%d",
                             var, obs_min, obs_max, imp_min, imp_max, out_of_range))
}

if(length(range_fails) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ PASS — All PMM imputed values lie within observed ranges\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d PMM variables have out-of-range imputed values:\n",
              length(range_fails)))
  for(msg in range_fails) cat("    ", msg, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}

# ── D3. Mean / SD comparison (observed vs imputed) ───────────────────────────
cat("D3. Observed vs imputed mean / SD comparison\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Under MAR the imputed and observed distributions\n")
cat("           should be broadly similar. Large standardised mean\n")
cat("           differences (|SMD| > 0.5) flag potential MNAR bias\n")
cat("           or miscoded variables and merit review.\n\n")

# Use scale items + key continuous variables that have missingness
# Restrict to numeric only — Fix B polr→PMM vars are factors and will
# cause errors in mean/var/sd calls downstream.
vars_for_qc <- names(imp_params$method[imp_params$method == "pmm"])
vars_for_qc <- vars_for_qc[vars_for_qc %in% names(df_imp)]
vars_for_qc <- vars_for_qc[sapply(df_imp[vars_for_qc], is.numeric)]
vars_for_qc <- vars_for_qc[colSums(is.na(df_imp[, vars_for_qc, drop = FALSE])) > 0]

quality_df <- data.frame()

for(var in vars_for_qc) {
  obs_vals <- df_imp[[var]][!is.na(df_imp[[var]])]
  if(length(obs_vals) < 5) next

  # Pool imputed values across all m datasets (only originally-missing cells)
  orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  if(sum(orig_na) == 0) next

  imp_vals <- unlist(lapply(all_imp_list, function(d) d[[var]][orig_na]))

  obs_mean <- mean(obs_vals);   obs_sd <- sd(obs_vals)
  imp_mean <- mean(imp_vals);   imp_sd <- sd(imp_vals)
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((obs_sd^2 + imp_sd^2) / 2)
  smd <- if(pooled_sd > 0) (imp_mean - obs_mean) / pooled_sd else 0

  quality_df <- rbind(quality_df, data.frame(
    variable     = var,
    n_missing    = sum(orig_na),
    obs_mean     = round(obs_mean, 3),
    obs_sd       = round(obs_sd,   3),
    imp_mean     = round(imp_mean, 3),
    imp_sd       = round(imp_sd,   3),
    mean_diff    = round(imp_mean - obs_mean, 3),
    sd_ratio     = round(imp_sd / obs_sd,     3),
    abs_smd      = round(abs(smd),            3),
    flag         = if(abs(smd) > 0.5) "⚠️ REVIEW" else "✓"
  ))
}

if(nrow(quality_df) > 0) {
  flagged <- quality_df[quality_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW", ]
  ok      <- quality_df[quality_df$flag == "✓", ]

  cat(sprintf("  Variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(quality_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Acceptable (|SMD| ≤ 0.5): %d\n", nrow(ok)))
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Review (|SMD| > 0.5):    %d\n\n", nrow(flagged)))

  if(nrow(flagged) > 0) {
    cat("  FLAGGED VARIABLES:\n")
    print(flagged[, c("variable","n_missing","obs_mean","imp_mean",
                      "obs_sd","imp_sd","abs_smd")],
          row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat("  SUMMARY STATISTICS (all assessed variables):\n")
  cat(sprintf("    Median |SMD|:  %.3f\n", median(quality_df$abs_smd)))
  cat(sprintf("    Max |SMD|:     %.3f\n", max(quality_df$abs_smd)))
  cat(sprintf("    Median SD ratio: %.3f\n", median(quality_df$sd_ratio)))
  cat(sprintf("    Max SD ratio:    %.3f\n\n", max(quality_df$sd_ratio)))

  write.csv(quality_df, "imputation_quality_assessment.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_quality_assessment.csv\n\n")
}

# ── D4. Between-imputation variance (relative variance increase) ─────────────
cat("D4. Between-imputation variance stability\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Rubin's rules decompose variance into within-imputation\n")
cat("           (W) and between-imputation (B) components. If B >> W\n")
cat("           for many variables, m may be too small or chains\n")
cat("           have not mixed. We compute the relative increase in\n")
cat("           variance (RIV = B/W) for continuous imputed variables.\n\n")

riv_df <- data.frame()

for(var in vars_for_qc[vars_for_qc %in% names(df_imp)]) {
  orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  if(sum(orig_na) < 5) next

  # Mean per imputation (among originally missing cells)
  imp_means <- sapply(all_imp_list, function(d) mean(d[[var]][orig_na], na.rm = TRUE))
  # Variance within each imputation
  imp_vars  <- sapply(all_imp_list, function(d) var( d[[var]][orig_na], na.rm = TRUE))

  m   <- length(imp_means)
  W   <- mean(imp_vars)                          # within-imputation variance
  B   <- var(imp_means)                          # between-imputation variance
  RIV <- if(W > 0) B / W else NA_real_           # relative increase in variance

  riv_df <- rbind(riv_df, data.frame(
    variable = var,
    W        = round(W,   4),
    B        = round(B,   4),
    RIV      = round(RIV, 4),
    flag     = if(!is.na(RIV) && RIV > 1.0) "⚠️ HIGH B" else "✓"
  ))
}

if(nrow(riv_df) > 0) {
  flagged_riv <- riv_df[!is.na(riv_df$flag) & riv_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH B", ]
  cat(sprintf("  Variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(riv_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Stable (RIV ≤ 1.0): %d\n", nrow(riv_df) - nrow(flagged_riv)))
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  High B/W (RIV > 1): %d\n", nrow(flagged_riv)))
  cat(sprintf("  Median RIV: %.4f\n", median(riv_df$RIV, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  Max RIV:    %.4f\n\n", max(riv_df$RIV, na.rm = TRUE)))

  if(nrow(flagged_riv) > 0) {
    cat("  HIGH RIV VARIABLES (B > W — consider increasing m):\n")
    print(flagged_riv %>% arrange(desc(RIV)) %>% head(10),
          row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }

  write.csv(riv_df %>% arrange(desc(RIV)),
            "imputation_variance_decomposition.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_variance_decomposition.csv\n\n")
}

# ── D5. Fraction of Missing Information (FMI) per variable ───────────────────
cat("D5. Fraction of Missing Information (FMI) per variable\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: FMI quantifies how much additional variance each\n")
cat("           variable's estimates carry due to missingness.\n")
cat("           FMI = (B + B/m) / (W + B + B/m)\n")
cat("           High FMI (> 0.5) means estimates for that variable\n")
cat("           are heavily influenced by the imputation model.\n\n")

fmi_df <- data.frame()

for(var in vars_for_qc[vars_for_qc %in% names(df_imp)]) {
  orig_na <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  if(sum(orig_na) < 5) next

  imp_means <- sapply(all_imp_list, function(d) mean(d[[var]][orig_na], na.rm = TRUE))
  imp_vars  <- sapply(all_imp_list, function(d) var( d[[var]][orig_na], na.rm = TRUE))

  m  <- length(imp_means)
  W  <- mean(imp_vars)
  B  <- var(imp_means)
  T_var <- W + B + B / m
  FMI   <- if(T_var > 0) (B + B / m) / T_var else NA_real_

  fmi_df <- rbind(fmi_df, data.frame(
    variable   = var,
    pct_missing = round(100 * sum(orig_na) / nrow(df_imp), 1),
    FMI        = round(FMI, 3),
    flag       = if(!is.na(FMI) && FMI > 0.5) "⚠️ HIGH" else "✓"
  ))
}

if(nrow(fmi_df) > 0) {
  high_fmi <- fmi_df[!is.na(fmi_df$flag) & fmi_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH", ]
  cat(sprintf("  Variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(fmi_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  Median FMI: %.3f\n", median(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  Max FMI:    %.3f\n", max(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("  High FMI (> 0.5): %d variables\n\n", nrow(high_fmi)))

  cat("  TOP 15 VARIABLES BY FMI:\n")
  print(fmi_df %>% arrange(desc(FMI)) %>% head(15) %>%
          select(variable, pct_missing, FMI, flag),
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")

  write.csv(fmi_df %>% arrange(desc(FMI)),
            "imputation_fmi_per_variable.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_fmi_per_variable.csv\n\n")
}

# ── D6. Categorical distribution preservation ─────────────────────────────────
cat("D6. Categorical distribution preservation\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: For polr/PMM-imputed ordered variables, check that\n")
cat("           the imputed category proportions are plausible\n")
cat("           relative to the observed proportions.\n\n")

ordered_imp_vars <- names(imp_params$method[
  imp_params$method %in% c("polr", "pmm") &
  names(imp_params$method) %in% imp_params$variable_types$ordered
])
ordered_imp_vars <- ordered_imp_vars[
  ordered_imp_vars %in% names(df_imp) &
  sapply(df_imp[ordered_imp_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x))) > 0
]

cat_check_df <- data.frame()

for(var in ordered_imp_vars) {
  orig_na  <- is.na(df_imp[[var]])
  obs_vals <- df_imp[[var]][!orig_na]
  if(length(obs_vals) == 0) next

  imp_vals <- unlist(lapply(all_imp_list, function(d) d[[var]][orig_na]))

  obs_props <- prop.table(table(obs_vals))
  imp_props <- prop.table(table(imp_vals))
  all_levs  <- union(names(obs_props), names(imp_props))

  max_diff <- max(abs(
    sapply(all_levs, function(lv)
      (if(lv %in% names(imp_props)) imp_props[lv] else 0) -
      (if(lv %in% names(obs_props)) obs_props[lv] else 0))
  ))

  cat_check_df <- rbind(cat_check_df, data.frame(
    variable  = var,
    n_missing = sum(orig_na),
    n_levels  = length(all_levs),
    max_prop_diff = round(max_diff, 3),
    flag = if(max_diff > 0.2) "⚠️ REVIEW" else "✓"
  ))
}

if(nrow(cat_check_df) > 0) {
  flagged_cat <- cat_check_df[cat_check_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW", ]
  cat(sprintf("  Ordered variables assessed: %d\n", nrow(cat_check_df)))
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Proportions stable (max diff ≤ 0.20): %d\n",
              nrow(cat_check_df) - nrow(flagged_cat)))
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  Large proportion shift (> 0.20):      %d\n\n",
              nrow(flagged_cat)))
  if(nrow(flagged_cat) > 0) {
    cat("  FLAGGED VARIABLES:\n")
    print(flagged_cat, row.names = FALSE)
    cat("\n")
  }
  write.csv(cat_check_df, "imputation_categorical_check.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_categorical_check.csv\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  No ordered variables with missingness to check\n\n")
}

# ── D7. Intra-scale correlation preservation ──────────────────────────────────
cat("D7. Intra-scale correlation preservation\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  PURPOSE: Items within the same scale (CISS, SURPS, DBAS) should\n")
cat("           remain highly correlated after imputation. A large drop\n")
cat("           in within-scale r suggests the imputation model broke\n")
cat("           the latent structure (e.g. due to minpuc removing too\n")
cat("           many within-scale predictors).\n\n")

scale_pairs <- list(
  CISS  = paste0("ciss",  1:21),
  SURPS = c(paste0("surps",  c(1,4,7,13,20,23), "_r"),
            paste0("surps",  setdiff(1:23, c(1,4,7,13,20,23)))),
  DBAS  = paste0("dbas_", 1:16),
  BFI   = c("reserved_r","lazy_r","relaxed_r","few_interests_r","find_fault_r",
            setdiff(c("outgoing","trusting","thorough","nervous","imaginative"),
                    c("reserved_r","lazy_r","relaxed_r","few_interests_r","find_fault_r")))
)

cor_check_df <- data.frame()

for(scale_name in names(scale_pairs)) {
  items <- scale_pairs[[scale_name]]
  items <- items[items %in% names(df_imp)]
  if(length(items) < 3) next

  # Observed correlation (complete cases only)
  obs_cc <- df_imp[complete.cases(df_imp[, items]), items]
  if(nrow(obs_cc) < 30) next
  obs_cor <- mean(abs(cor(obs_cc, use = "complete.obs")[upper.tri(
    cor(obs_cc, use = "complete.obs"))]))

  # Average across imputed datasets
  imp_cors <- sapply(all_imp_list, function(d) {
    c_mat <- cor(d[, items], use = "complete.obs")
    mean(abs(c_mat[upper.tri(c_mat)]))
  })
  imp_cor <- mean(imp_cors)
  cor_drop <- obs_cor - imp_cor

  cor_check_df <- rbind(cor_check_df, data.frame(
    scale       = scale_name,
    n_items     = length(items),
    obs_mean_r  = round(obs_cor, 3),
    imp_mean_r  = round(imp_cor, 3),
    r_drop      = round(cor_drop, 3),
    flag        = if(cor_drop > 0.1) "⚠️ DROP" else "✓"
  ))
}

if(nrow(cor_check_df) > 0) {
  cat("  Scale-level correlation summary:\n")
  print(cor_check_df, row.names = FALSE)
  flagged_cor <- cor_check_df[cor_check_df$flag == "⚠️ DROP", ]
  if(nrow(flagged_cor) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\n  ⚠️  %d scale(s) show r drop > 0.1 — review minpuc setting\n",
                nrow(flagged_cor)))
  } else {
    cat("\n  ✓ Within-scale correlations preserved across all scales\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  write.csv(cor_check_df, "imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓ Saved: imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: RECALCULATE DERIVED VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: RECALCULATING DERIVED VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ── Correct approach: modify the list of completed datasets ──────────────────
# The mids object itself cannot store extra variables cleanly.
# We work on all_imp_list (already extracted above) and add derived vars there.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

if(!is.null(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate) &&
   length(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate) > 0) {

  cat("Variables to recalculate post-imputation:\n")
  for(var in imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate)
    cat("  •", var, "\n")
  cat("\n")

  cat("Recalculating for all", imp_params$optimal_m, "imputed datasets...\n")

  for(i in seq_along(all_imp_list)) {
    d <- all_imp_list[[i]]

    if(all(c("n_physical_conditions","n_ment_conditions","n_sleep_conditions")
           %in% names(d))) {
      all_imp_list[[i]]$n_health_conditions <-
        d$n_physical_conditions + d$n_ment_conditions + d$n_sleep_conditions
    }
  }

  # Verify
  d1 <- all_imp_list[[1]]
  n_correct <- sum(
    d1$n_health_conditions ==
    (d1$n_physical_conditions + d1$n_ment_conditions + d1$n_sleep_conditions),
    na.rm = TRUE)

  if(n_correct == nrow(d1)) {
    cat("  ✓ Verified: n_health_conditions correct in all",
        nrow(d1), "rows (imputation 1)\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️  Mismatch in", nrow(d1) - n_correct, "rows — investigate\n\n")
  }

} else {
  cat("  No derived variables to recalculate\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: ADD OUTCOME VARIABLE BACK
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: ADDING OUTCOME VARIABLE BACK\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {
  SIMOA_original <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")

  # Find outcome from excluded_variables (first non-derived entry)
  outcome_var <- imp_params$excluded_variables[
    !imp_params$excluded_variables %in%
      c(imp_params$derived_variables_to_recalculate, "n_health_conditions")
  ]
  outcome_var <- outcome_var[1]

  if(!is.na(outcome_var) && outcome_var %in% names(SIMOA_original)) {
    outcome_data <- SIMOA_original[[outcome_var]]

    for(i in seq_along(all_imp_list))
      all_imp_list[[i]][[outcome_var]] <- outcome_data

    cat("✓ Outcome variable added:", outcome_var, "\n")
    cat("  Distribution:\n")
    print(table(all_imp_list[[1]][[outcome_var]], useNA = "ifany"))
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠️  Outcome variable not found in original dataset\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠️  SIMOA_analysis.rds not found — outcome not added\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: SAVE OUTPUTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: SAVING OUTPUTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

saveRDS(imp_final,    "mice_imputation_object.rds")
saveRDS(all_imp_list, "imputed_datasets_final.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: mice_imputation_object.rds\n")
cat("  (mids object — use with mice::pool() for analysis)\n")
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
cat("  (List of", length(all_imp_list), "complete datasets with all variables)\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART H: FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("IMPUTATION COMPLETE — SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION SPECIFICATIONS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Observations:             ", nrow(df_imp), "\n")
cat("  Variables imputed:        ", imp_params$n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
cat("  m (imputations):          ", imp_params$optimal_m, "\n")
cat("  maxit (iterations):       ", imp_params$optimal_maxit, "\n")
cat("  Ridge penalty:            ", imp_params$ridge_penalty, "\n")
cat("  Time elapsed:             ", round(as.numeric(elapsed_time), 2), "minutes\n\n")

cat("IMPUTATION METHODS:\n")
cat("  PMM (continuous):  ", sum(imp_params$method == "pmm"),     "\n")
cat("  Logreg (binary):   ", sum(imp_params$method == "logreg"),  "\n")
cat("  Polr (ordered):    ", sum(imp_params$method == "polr"),    "\n")
cat("  Polyreg (unordered):", sum(imp_params$method == "polyreg"), "\n\n")

cat("STATISTICAL VERIFICATION SUMMARY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# Convergence
if(!is.null(psrf_final)) {
  psrf_clean2 <- psrf_final[!is.na(psrf_final) & is.finite(psrf_final)]
  conv_status <- if(max(psrf_clean2) < 1.1) "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  FAIL"
  cat(sprintf("  D1. Convergence (PSRF):          %s  max=%.4f mean=%.4f\n",
              conv_status, max(psrf_clean2), mean(psrf_clean2)))
}

# Completeness
comp_status <- if(length(completeness_fails) == 0) "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  FAIL"
cat(sprintf("  D2. Completeness:                %s\n", comp_status))

# Range
range_status <- if(length(range_fails) == 0) "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  REVIEW"
cat(sprintf("  D3. PMM range preservation:      %s\n", range_status))

# SMD
if(nrow(quality_df) > 0) {
  smd_status <- if(sum(quality_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW") == 0) "✓ PASS" else
    sprintf("⚠️  %d vars flagged", sum(quality_df$flag == "⚠️ REVIEW"))
  cat(sprintf("  D4. Mean/SD (|SMD| ≤ 0.5):       %s\n", smd_status))
}

# RIV
if(nrow(riv_df) > 0) {
  riv_status <- if(sum(riv_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH B", na.rm=TRUE) == 0) "✓ PASS" else
    sprintf("⚠️  %d vars flagged", sum(riv_df$flag == "⚠️ HIGH B", na.rm=TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("  D5. Between-imputation variance: %s\n", riv_status))
}

# FMI
if(nrow(fmi_df) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("  D6. FMI (median / max):          %.3f / %.3f\n",
              median(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm=TRUE), max(fmi_df$FMI, na.rm=TRUE)))

# Categorical
if(nrow(cat_check_df) > 0) {
  cat_status <- if(nrow(flagged_cat) == 0) "✓ PASS" else
    sprintf("⚠️  %d vars flagged", nrow(flagged_cat))
  cat(sprintf("  D7. Categorical proportions:     %s\n", cat_status))
}

# Scale correlations
if(nrow(cor_check_df) > 0) {
  cor_status <- if(nrow(cor_check_df[cor_check_df$flag == "⚠️ DROP",]) == 0)
    "✓ PASS" else "⚠️  REVIEW"
  cat(sprintf("  D8. Intra-scale correlations:    %s\n", cor_status))
}

cat("\n")
cat("LOGGED EVENTS:\n")
if(n_logged == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ None — imputation completed cleanly\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %d events — review imputation_logged_events.csv\n\n", n_logged))
}

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1.  mice_imputation_object.rds           - mids object for pooling\n")
cat("  2.  imputed_datasets_final.rds           - List of complete datasets\n")
cat("  3.  convergence_trace_plots_final.pdf    - Trace plots\n")
cat("  4.  imputation_density_plots.pdf         - Observed vs imputed densities\n")
cat("  5.  imputation_stripplots.pdf            - Ordered variable stripplots\n")
cat("  6.  final_imputation_psrf.csv            - PSRF per variable\n")
cat("  7.  imputation_quality_assessment.csv    - Obs vs imp mean/SD/SMD\n")
cat("  8.  imputation_variance_decomposition.csv - W, B, RIV per variable\n")
cat("  9.  imputation_fmi_per_variable.csv      - FMI per variable\n")
cat("  10. imputation_categorical_check.csv     - Ordered variable proportions\n")
cat("  11. imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv - Within-scale r preservation\n")
if(n_logged > 0)
  cat("  12. imputation_logged_events.csv        - Logged events during imputation\n")

cat("\n")
cat("NEXT STEPS:\n")
cat("  1. Review convergence_trace_plots_final.pdf  — chains should intermingle\n")
cat("  2. Review imputation_density_plots.pdf        — obs/imp distributions\n")
cat("  3. Check imputation_quality_assessment.csv    — flag any |SMD| > 0.5\n")
cat("  4. Check imputation_scale_correlation_check.csv — verify latent structure\n")
cat("  5. If all checks pass → Proceed to analysis (Chunk 9)\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ MULTIPLE IMPUTATION COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

```




## Post-MI Processing
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 9: POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   1. Create validated personality subscales using already-reversed items
#   2. Calculate reliability metrics
#   All operations performed on EACH imputed dataset separately
#
# NOTE ON DATA SOURCE:
#   Loads imputed_datasets_final.rds (list of 25 complete data frames).
#   n_health_conditions and scrn_stopped_bzra were already added in Chunk 8
#   — no re-derivation needed here.
#
# NOTE ON REVERSED ITEMS:
#   All reversals were performed in Chunk 6 and are present in the imputed
#   data under their _r names:
#     BFI:   reserved_r, lazy_r, relaxed_r, few_interests_r, find_fault_r
#     SURPS: surps1_r, surps4_r, surps7_r, surps13_r, surps20_r, surps23_r
#   Subscale definitions below use these _r names directly.
#
# NOTE ON DBAS NAMING:
#   First item has no underscore: dbas1
#   Remaining items use underscore: dbas_2 through dbas_16
#==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(psych)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed datasets (list of 25 complete data frames from Chunk 8)
if(!file.exists("imputed_datasets_final.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_final.rds not found. Please run Chunk 8 first.")
}

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_final.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)

cat("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_final.rds\n")
cat("  Imputations:", m, "\n")
cat("  Variables per dataset:", ncol(all_imputed[[1]]), "\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(all_imputed[[1]]), "\n\n")

# Verify expected variables are present
cat("VERIFICATION: Checking reversed items from Chunk 6\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

reversed_items_expected <- c(
  "reserved_r", "lazy_r", "relaxed_r", "few_interests_r", "find_fault_r",
  "surps1_r", "surps4_r", "surps7_r", "surps13_r", "surps20_r", "surps23_r"
)

present   <- reversed_items_expected[reversed_items_expected %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]
absent    <- reversed_items_expected[!reversed_items_expected %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]

cat(sprintf("  ✓ Reversed items present: %d / %d\n",
            length(present), length(reversed_items_expected)))
if(length(absent) > 0) {
  cat("  ✗ MISSING reversed items:\n")
  for(v in absent) cat("    •", v, "\n")
  stop("Cannot proceed — reversed items missing from imputed data.")
}
cat("\n")

# Also verify n_health_conditions and outcome are already present (Chunk 8)
cat("VERIFICATION: Checking Chunk 8 post-processing variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(v in c("n_health_conditions", "scrn_stopped_bzra")) {
  if(v %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %s present (added in Chunk 8)\n", v))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️  %s NOT present — check Chunk 8 output\n", v))
  }
}
cat("\n")

# =============================================================================
# SUBSCALE DEFINITIONS
# =============================================================================
# Each entry: list(items = character vector, reversed_in_chunk6 = which _r names)
# All items listed here are the FINAL variable names as they exist in df_imp.
# =============================================================================

subscale_defs <- list(

  # ── BFI-10 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2 items per trait. Reversed items stored as _r (Chunk 6).
  BFI_Extraversion      = list(items = c("reserved_r", "outgoing"),
                                reversed = "reserved_r"),
  BFI_Agreeableness     = list(items = c("find_fault_r", "trusting"),
                                reversed = "find_fault_r"),
  BFI_Conscientiousness = list(items = c("lazy_r", "thorough"),
                                reversed = "lazy_r"),
  BFI_Neuroticism       = list(items = c("relaxed_r", "nervous"),
                                reversed = "relaxed_r"),
  BFI_Openness          = list(items = c("few_interests_r", "imagination"),
                                reversed = "few_interests_r"),

  # ── SURPS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Hopelessness items 1,4,7,13,20,23 were reversed in Chunk 6 → _r names.
  # Item 17 was NOT reversed — kept as surps17.
  SURPS_Hopelessness        = list(
    items    = c("surps1_r", "surps4_r", "surps7_r", "surps13_r",
                 "surps17", "surps20_r", "surps23_r"),
    reversed = c("surps1_r", "surps4_r", "surps7_r", "surps13_r",
                 "surps20_r", "surps23_r")),
  SURPS_Impulsivity         = list(
    items    = paste0("surps", c(2, 5, 11, 15, 22)),
    reversed = character(0)),
  SURPS_Sensation_Seeking   = list(
    items    = paste0("surps", c(3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 19)),
    reversed = character(0)),
  SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity = list(
    items    = paste0("surps", c(8, 10, 14, 18, 21)),
    reversed = character(0)),

  # ── DBAS-16 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # dbas1 has no underscore; dbas_2 through dbas_16 have underscore.
  # No reverse coding for DBAS.
  #
  # Variable mapping derived from Morin et al. second-order CFA (DBAS-30 item
  # numbers in parentheses):
  #   Consequences (7):       dbas_3(5), dbas_4(8), dbas_5(10), dbas_7(12),
  #                           dbas_9(18), dbas_12(21), dbas_16(30)
  #   Worry/Helplessness (4): dbas_8(17), dbas_10(19), dbas_11(20), dbas_14(25)
  #   Expectations (2):       dbas1(1), dbas_2(2)
  #   Medication (3):         dbas_6(11), dbas_13(24), dbas_15(27)
  DBAS_Consequences       = list(
    items    = c("dbas_3", "dbas_4", "dbas_5", "dbas_7",
                 "dbas_9", "dbas_12", "dbas_16"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Worry_Helplessness = list(
    items    = c("dbas_8", "dbas_10", "dbas_11", "dbas_14"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Expectations       = list(
    items    = c("dbas1", "dbas_2"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Medications        = list(
    items    = c("dbas_6", "dbas_13", "dbas_15"),
    reversed = character(0)),
  DBAS_Total              = list(
    items    = c("dbas1", paste0("dbas_", 2:16)),
    reversed = character(0)),

  # ── CISS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # No reverse coding for CISS.
  CISS_Task      = list(items = paste0("ciss", c(2, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, 19)),
                         reversed = character(0)),
  CISS_Emotion   = list(items = paste0("ciss", c(3, 5, 10, 12, 14, 17, 20)),
                         reversed = character(0)),
  CISS_Avoidance = list(items = paste0("ciss", c(1, 4, 7, 9, 15, 18, 21)),
                         reversed = character(0))
)

# =============================================================================
# HELPER: Reliability assessment
# =============================================================================

assess_reliability <- function(data, items, name) {

  missing_items <- items[!items %in% names(data)]
  if(length(missing_items) > 0)
    return(list(name = name, alpha = NA, alpha_ci_lower = NA,
                alpha_ci_upper = NA, mean_r = NA,
                mean = NA, sd = NA, status = "MISSING ITEMS",
                missing = missing_items))

  item_data <- data[, items, drop = FALSE]
  item_data <- item_data[complete.cases(item_data), ]

  if(nrow(item_data) < 10)
    return(list(name = name, alpha = NA, alpha_ci_lower = NA,
                alpha_ci_upper = NA, mean_r = NA,
                mean = NA, sd = NA, status = "INSUFFICIENT DATA",
                missing = character(0)))

  item_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(item_data, as.numeric))

  # Check variance
  if(any(sapply(item_matrix, sd, na.rm = TRUE) == 0))
    return(list(name = name, alpha = NA, alpha_ci_lower = NA,
                alpha_ci_upper = NA, mean_r = NA,
                mean = NA, sd = NA, status = "ZERO VARIANCE",
                missing = character(0)))

  alpha_result <- tryCatch(
    psych::alpha(item_matrix, check.keys = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL)

  if(is.null(alpha_result))
    return(list(name = name, alpha = NA, alpha_ci_lower = NA,
                alpha_ci_upper = NA, mean_r = NA,
                mean = NA, sd = NA, status = "ALPHA FAILED",
                missing = character(0)))

  scores   <- rowMeans(item_matrix)
  cor_mat  <- cor(item_matrix, use = "complete.obs")

  list(
    name           = name,
    n_items        = length(items),
    alpha          = alpha_result$total$raw_alpha,
    alpha_ci_lower = alpha_result$feldt$lower.ci,
    alpha_ci_upper = alpha_result$feldt$upper.ci,
    mean_r         = mean(cor_mat[lower.tri(cor_mat)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean           = mean(scores, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd             = sd(scores,   na.rm = TRUE),
    status         = dplyr::case_when(
      alpha_result$total$raw_alpha >= 0.70 ~ "GOOD",
      alpha_result$total$raw_alpha >= 0.60 ~ "ACCEPTABLE",
      TRUE                                 ~ "POOR"),
    missing        = character(0)
  )
}

# =============================================================================
# PART A: VALIDATE ITEM NAMES BEFORE CREATING SUBSCALES
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: VALIDATING ITEM NAMES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

all_item_names <- unique(unlist(lapply(subscale_defs, `[[`, "items")))
missing_items  <- all_item_names[!all_item_names %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]
present_items  <- all_item_names[ all_item_names %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]

cat(sprintf("  Total unique items across all subscales: %d\n",
            length(all_item_names)))
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Present in data: %d\n", length(present_items)))

if(length(missing_items) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ MISSING from data: %d\n", length(missing_items)))
  for(v in missing_items) cat("    •", v, "\n")
  cat("\n  ⚠️  Missing items will cause those subscales to be skipped.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ All items present — subscale creation can proceed\n\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# PART B: CREATE SUBSCALES ACROSS ALL IMPUTED DATASETS
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: CREATING SUBSCALES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Scoring method: MEAN of items (interpretable on original scale)\n")
cat("Applied to all", m, "imputed datasets\n\n")

# Apply subscale scoring to every dataset in the list
subscales_created <- character(0)
subscales_skipped <- character(0)

all_imputed <- lapply(all_imputed, function(d) {
  for(scale_name in names(subscale_defs)) {
    items <- subscale_defs[[scale_name]]$items
    # Only score if ALL items present and numeric-coercible
    if(all(items %in% names(d))) {
      item_mat <- as.data.frame(lapply(d[, items, drop = FALSE], as.numeric))
      d[[scale_name]] <- rowMeans(item_mat, na.rm = FALSE)
    }
  }
  d
})

# Determine which subscales were actually created
for(scale_name in names(subscale_defs)) {
  if(scale_name %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])) {
    subscales_created <- c(subscales_created, scale_name)
  } else {
    subscales_skipped <- c(subscales_skipped, scale_name)
  }
}

# Report by scale family
families <- list(
  "BFI-10"  = grep("^BFI_",  subscales_created, value = TRUE),
  "SURPS"   = grep("^SURPS_", subscales_created, value = TRUE),
  "DBAS-16" = grep("^DBAS_", subscales_created, value = TRUE),
  "CISS"    = grep("^CISS_", subscales_created, value = TRUE)
)

for(fam in names(families)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s (%d subscales):\n", fam, length(families[[fam]])))
  for(s in families[[fam]]) {
    n_rev <- length(subscale_defs[[s]]$reversed)

      sprintf(" [%d item(s) reversed in Chunk 6]", n_rev) else ""

                s,
                paste(subscale_defs[[s]]$items, collapse = ", "),
                rev_note))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

if(length(subscales_skipped) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  SKIPPED (%d) — missing items:\n", length(subscales_skipped)))
  for(s in subscales_skipped) cat("  •", s, "\n")

}

cat(sprintf("Total subscales created: %d\n\n", length(subscales_created)))

# =============================================================================
# PART C: RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT (IMPUTATION 1)
# =============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Using first imputed dataset (reliability is stable across imputations\n")
cat("given low FMI; van Buuren, 2018 §6.6).\n\n")
cat("NOTE: BFI-10 subscales each have 2 items. psych::alpha() on 2-item\n")
cat("  scales computes a Spearman-Brown coefficient, not true Cronbach's α.\n")
cat("  Interpret BFI α values as corrected item-total correlations rather\n")
cat("  than internal consistency estimates.\n\n")

data_imp1        <- all_imputed[[1]]
reliability_list <- list()

for(fam in names(families)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s:\n", fam))
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

  for(scale_name in families[[fam]]) {
    items  <- subscale_defs[[scale_name]]$items
    result <- assess_reliability(data_imp1, items, scale_name)
    reliability_list[[scale_name]] <- result

    if(!is.na(result$alpha)) {
      status_sym <- switch(result$status,
                           "GOOD"       = "✓",
                           "ACCEPTABLE" = "~",
                           "POOR"       = "⚠️",
                           "?")
      cat(sprintf("  %s %-30s α = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]  mean-r = %.3f  M = %.2f (SD = %.2f)  [%s]\n",
                  status_sym, scale_name,
                  result$alpha, result$alpha_ci_lower, result$alpha_ci_upper,
                  result$mean_r, result$mean, result$sd, result$status))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  ✗ %-30s STATUS: %s\n", scale_name, result$status))
      if(length(result$missing) > 0)
        cat("    Missing:", paste(result$missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Reliability summary table
rel_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(reliability_list), function(s) {
  r <- reliability_list[[s]]
  data.frame(
    subscale       = s,
    n_items        = length(subscale_defs[[s]]$items),   # base R — no %||% needed
    n_reversed     = length(subscale_defs[[s]]$reversed),
    alpha          = round(r$alpha,          3),
    alpha_ci_lower = round(r$alpha_ci_lower, 3),
    alpha_ci_upper = round(r$alpha_ci_upper, 3),
    mean_inter_r   = round(r$mean_r,         3),
    mean           = round(r$mean,           2),
    sd             = round(r$sd,             2),
    status         = r$status,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

write.csv(rel_table, "subscale_reliability_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

}
if(completeness_fails == 0L)

# ── D3. Reversed items used, not originals ────────────────────────────────────
cat("D3. Reversed item name check\n")

original_names_that_should_be_reversed <- list(

}
cat("\n")

# ── D4. Subscale range plausibility ───────────────────────────────────────────
```

## Descriptive Stats
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 10: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS & GROUP COMPARISONS
# Pooled across all m imputations using Rubin's Rules
#==============================================================================
#
# DATA SOURCE:
#   Loads imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds — a plain list of m complete
#   data frames produced by Chunk 9. No mids object needed here.
#
# POOLING METHODS:
#
#   Continuous variables:
#     - Pooled mean:  Q_bar = mean of per-imputation means
#     - Pooled variance (Rubin's Rules):
#         W = mean of within-imputation variances  (average SE^2)
#         B = variance of per-imputation means     (between-imputation variance)
#         T = W + (1 + 1/m) * B                   (total variance)
#     - Pooled SD reported as sqrt of pooled within-imputation variance (W),
#       which reflects typical within-sample spread, not estimation uncertainty
#     - Group comparison: pool t-statistics via Li et al. (1991) method,
#       which gives a valid p-value from pooled F/t
#
#   Categorical variables:
#     - Pooled proportion: mean of per-imputation proportions per level
#     - Pooled n(%): pooled proportion * N
#     - Group comparison: pool chi-square statistics (mean across imputations),
#       test against chi-square distribution (Enders, 2010 approach)
#
#   Effect sizes:
#     - Cohen's d: computed from pooled means and pooled within-SD
#     - Cramer's V: computed from pooled chi-square statistic
#
#   FDR: Benjamini-Hochberg applied to pooled p-values within families
#
# REFERENCES:
#   Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#   Li, K.H., Raghunathan, T.E., & Rubin, D.B. (1991). Statistica Sinica.
#   Enders, C.K. (2010). Applied Missing Data Analysis.
#   Benjamini, Y., & Hochberg, Y. (1995). JRSS-B, 57(1), 289-300.
#==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

cat("\n")
cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS & GROUP COMPARISONS\n")
cat("(Pooled across all imputations — Rubin's Rules)\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
# Chunk 9 output: plain list of m complete data frames
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!file.exists("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)
N           <- nrow(all_imputed[[1]])

cat(sprintf("Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n", N))
cat(sprintf("  Variables per dataset: %d\n\n", ncol(all_imputed[[1]])))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RECODE FUNCTION — applied to each imputed dataset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

recode_dataset <- function(df) {

  # Sex
  if("sex" %in% names(df))
    df$sex <- factor(df$sex, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Female","Male"))

  # Province/Territory
  if("prov_terr" %in% names(df)) {
    df$prov_terr <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$prov_terr %in% c(1,2,3,12) ~ "Western Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(9,11)     ~ "Central Canada",
      df$prov_terr %in% c(4,5,7,10) ~ "Atlantic Canada",
      TRUE                           ~ "Territories"
    )
    df$prov_terr <- factor(df$prov_terr,
      levels = c("Western Canada","Central Canada","Atlantic Canada","Territories"))
  }

  # Employment
  if("employment" %in% names(df)) {
    df$employment <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$employment %in% c(0,3,4) ~ "Not in Workforce",
      df$employment %in% c(1,2)   ~ "Full- or Part-Time Work",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$employment <- factor(df$employment,
      levels = c("Full- or Part-Time Work","Not in Workforce"))
  }

  # Education
  if("education" %in% names(df)) {
    df$education <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$education %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "High School or Less",
      df$education %in% c(4,5)   ~ "Trade School/University Degree",
      TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$education <- factor(df$education,
      levels = c("High School or Less","Trade School/University Degree"))
  }

  # Income
  if("income" %in% names(df))
    df$income <- factor(df$income, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("$15,000 or less","$15,000 to $30,000","$30,000 to $50,000",
                 "$50,000 to $80,000","$80,000 or more"))

  # Driving frequency
  if("driving_freq" %in% names(df))
    df$driving_freq <- factor(df$driving_freq, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Do not drive","Less than 1 day/week","1-3 days/week","4-7 days/week"))

  # General health
  if("gen_health" %in% names(df))
    df$gen_health <- factor(df$gen_health, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("Poor","Fair","Good","Very good","Excellent"))

  # Sleep substance use frequency
  sleep_freq_labels <- c("Less than 1 day/week","1-3 days/week",
                         "4-6 days/week","7 days/week")
  for(sv in c("alc_sleep","can_sleep","melatonin_use","op_sleep"))
    if(sv %in% names(df))
      df[[sv]] <- factor(df[[sv]], levels = 1:4, labels = sleep_freq_labels)

  # Withdrawal experience
  if("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(df))
    df$stop_wdl_exp_combined <- factor(df$stop_wdl_exp_combined, levels = 0:5,
      labels = c("No withdrawal","Insomnia only","Anxiety only",
                 "Other MH symptoms only","Physical symptoms only","Multiple symptoms"))

  # Stop rate (ordered: 0=abruptly, 1=slowly 1-4wk, 2=very slowly >4wk)
  if("stop_rate_dc" %in% names(df))
    df$stop_rate_dc <- factor(df$stop_rate_dc, levels = 0:2,
      labels = c("Abruptly (cold turkey)",
                 "Slowly (1-4 weeks)",
                 "Very slowly (>4 weeks)"),
      ordered = TRUE)

  # Likert scales to numeric (Fix B polr→PMM vars may still be stored as factors)
  likert_vars <- c(
    paste0("side_effects_", 1:4), paste0("safety_", 1:4),
    paste0("adls_", 1:2), paste0("dependence_", 1:3),
    "med_burden_1", "med_burden2", "medburden_3", "med_burden_4",
    "benefit_1", "benefit_4", "benefit_5", "benefit_6", "benefit_dep",
    "memory","thinking","activities","socialize","driving",
    "balance","falls","indication","efficacy","alternative",
    "inf_soc","inf_pres","inf_rphc","interactions",
    "dependence","reduc","cost"
  )
  for(var in likert_vars)
    if(var %in% names(df) && !is.numeric(df[[var]]))
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[var]]))

  df
}

#==============================================================================
# POOLING FUNCTIONS
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POOL CONTINUOUS VARIABLE
# Returns: overall Mean(SD), group means/SDs, pooled t-test p-value, Cohen's d
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pool_continuous <- function(var, datasets, outcome = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {

  imp_stats <- lapply(datasets, function(df) {
    x   <- as.numeric(df[[var]])
    grp <- df[[outcome]]
    x0  <- x[grp == 0]; x1 <- x[grp == 1]
    n0  <- sum(!is.na(x0)); n1 <- sum(!is.na(x1))
    if(n0 < 2 || n1 < 2) return(NULL)

    m0  <- mean(x0, na.rm=TRUE); m1 <- mean(x1, na.rm=TRUE)
    v0  <- var(x0, na.rm=TRUE);  v1 <- var(x1, na.rm=TRUE)
    m_all <- mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)
    v_all <- var(x, na.rm=TRUE)

    # Pooled within-group SD for Cohen's d
    sp  <- sqrt(((n0-1)*v0 + (n1-1)*v1) / (n0+n1-2))

    # Standard error of mean difference
    se_diff <- sqrt(v0/n0 + v1/n1)

    list(m_all=m_all, v_all=v_all,
         m0=m0, v0=v0, n0=n0,
         m1=m1, v1=v1, n1=n1,
         diff=m1-m0, se_diff=se_diff, sp=sp)
  })
  imp_stats <- Filter(Negate(is.null), imp_stats)
  if(length(imp_stats) == 0) return(NULL)

  mm <- length(imp_stats)

  # Pool overall
  pool_m_all  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "m_all"))
  pool_v_all  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "v_all"))
  pool_sd_all <- sqrt(pool_v_all)

  # Pool group 0 (continued)
  pool_m0  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "m0"))
  pool_v0  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "v0"))
  pool_sd0 <- sqrt(pool_v0)
  n0       <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n0")))

  # Pool group 1 (discontinued)
  pool_m1  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "m1"))
  pool_v1  <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "v1"))
  pool_sd1 <- sqrt(pool_v1)
  n1       <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n1")))

  # Rubin's Rules for mean difference
  diffs  <- sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "diff")
  se2s   <- sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "se_diff")^2
  Q_bar  <- mean(diffs)
  W      <- mean(se2s)
  B      <- var(diffs)
  T_var  <- W + (1 + 1/mm) * B
  t_stat <- Q_bar / sqrt(T_var)

  # Barnard-Rubin degrees of freedom
  lambda <- (1 + 1/mm) * B / T_var
  df_old <- (n0 + n1 - 2)
  df_obs <- (1 - lambda) * df_old * (df_old + 1) / (df_old + 3)
  df_m   <- (mm - 1) / lambda^2
  df     <- 1 / (1/df_m + 1/df_obs)
  p_val  <- 2 * pt(abs(t_stat), df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  # Cohen's d
  pool_sp <- mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "sp"))
  d       <- if(pool_sp > 0) Q_bar / pool_sp else NA_real_
  se_d    <- sqrt((n0+n1)/(n0*n1) + d^2 / (2*(n0+n1-2)))

  list(
    type         = "continuous",
    overall_desc = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", pool_m_all, pool_sd_all),
    cont_desc    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", pool_m0,    pool_sd0),
    disc_desc    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", pool_m1,    pool_sd1),
    p_val        = p_val,
    effect_type  = "Cohens_d",
    effect_size  = round(d, 3),
    ci_low       = round(d - 1.96*se_d, 3),
    ci_high      = round(d + 1.96*se_d, 3)
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POOL CATEGORICAL VARIABLE
# Returns: per-level pooled n(%), pooled chi-square p-value, Cramer's V
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pool_categorical <- function(var, datasets, outcome = "scrn_stopped_bzra") {

  lvls <- levels(datasets[[1]][[var]])
  if(is.null(lvls)) return(NULL)

  imp_stats <- lapply(datasets, function(df) {

    fac_var <- factor(df[[var]], levels = lvls)

    # Outcome may be numeric 0/1 — use numeric levels to avoid NAs
    out_vals <- df[[outcome]]
    fac_out  <- factor(out_vals, levels = c(0, 1))

    tab <- table(fac_var, fac_out)
    colnames(tab) <- c("0","1")

    if(!all(c("0","1") %in% colnames(tab))) return(NULL)

    n0   <- sum(tab[,"0"])
    n1   <- sum(tab[,"1"])
    ntot <- n0 + n1
    if(n0 == 0 || n1 == 0) return(NULL)

    p_all <- rowSums(tab) / ntot
    p0    <- tab[,"0"] / n0
    p1    <- tab[,"1"] / n1

    # Drop zero-total rows before chi-square (avoids chisq.test errors)
    tab_nz <- tab[rowSums(tab) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    chi2 <- tryCatch({
      if(nrow(tab_nz) < 2) NA_real_
      else suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab_nz, correct = FALSE)$statistic)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

    list(p_all=p_all, p0=p0, p1=p1,
         n0=n0, n1=n1, ntot=ntot,
         chi2=chi2, k=length(lvls))
  })
  imp_stats <- Filter(Negate(is.null), imp_stats)
  if(length(imp_stats) == 0) return(NULL)

  n0   <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n0")))
  n1   <- round(mean(sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "n1")))
  ntot <- n0 + n1

  # Pool proportions — ensure all levels present in each named vector
  safe_pool <- function(field) {
    mat <- sapply(imp_stats, function(s) {
      v   <- s[[field]]
      out <- setNames(rep(0, length(lvls)), lvls)
      out[names(v)] <- v
      out
    })
    if(is.null(dim(mat))) mat <- matrix(mat, nrow = length(lvls))
    rowMeans(mat)
  }

  pool_p_all <- safe_pool("p_all")
  pool_p0    <- safe_pool("p0")
  pool_p1    <- safe_pool("p1")

  # Pool chi-square (mean of valid values across imputations)
  chi2_vals <- sapply(imp_stats, `[[`, "chi2")
  chi2_vals <- chi2_vals[!is.na(chi2_vals)]
  pool_chi2 <- if(length(chi2_vals) > 0) mean(chi2_vals) else NA_real_
  k         <- imp_stats[[1]]$k
  df_chi    <- max(k - 1, 1)
  p_val     <- if(!is.na(pool_chi2)) pchisq(pool_chi2, df=df_chi, lower.tail=FALSE) else NA_real_

  # Cramer's V
  denom_k <- max(min(k, 2) - 1, 1)
  v <- if(!is.na(pool_chi2) && ntot > 0)
    min(sqrt(pool_chi2 / (ntot * denom_k)), 1) else NA_real_
  se_v <- if(!is.na(v)) sqrt((1 - v^2)^2 / (ntot - 1)) else NA_real_

  # Build per-level display rows
  level_rows <- data.frame(
    level        = lvls,
    overall_n    = round(pool_p_all * ntot),
    overall_pct  = round(pool_p_all * 100, 1),
    cont_n       = round(pool_p0 * n0),
    cont_pct     = round(pool_p0 * 100, 1),
    disc_n       = round(pool_p1 * n1),
    disc_pct     = round(pool_p1 * 100, 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  level_rows$overall_desc <- sprintf("%d (%.1f)", level_rows$overall_n, level_rows$overall_pct)
  level_rows$cont_desc    <- sprintf("%d (%.1f)", level_rows$cont_n,    level_rows$cont_pct)
  level_rows$disc_desc    <- sprintf("%d (%.1f)", level_rows$disc_n,    level_rows$disc_pct)

  list(
    type         = "categorical",
    levels       = level_rows,
    p_val        = p_val,
    effect_type  = "Cramers_V",
    effect_size  = if(!is.na(v)) round(v, 3) else NA_real_,
    ci_low       = if(!is.na(v) && !is.na(se_v)) round(max(0, v - 1.96*se_v), 3) else NA_real_,
    ci_high      = if(!is.na(v) && !is.na(se_v)) round(min(1, v + 1.96*se_v), 3) else NA_real_
  )
}

#==============================================================================
# EFFECT SIZE INTERPRETATION
#==============================================================================

interpret_d <- function(d) {
  d <- abs(d)
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(d)  ~ "N/A",
    d < 0.20  ~ "Negligible",
    d < 0.50  ~ "Small",
    d < 0.80  ~ "Medium",
    TRUE      ~ "Large"
  )
}

interpret_v <- function(v) {
  v <- abs(v)
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(v)  ~ "N/A",
    v < 0.10  ~ "Negligible",
    v < 0.30  ~ "Small",
    v < 0.50  ~ "Medium",
    TRUE      ~ "Large"
  )
}

#==============================================================================
# BUILD RESULTS DATA FRAME
#==============================================================================

summary_rows <- map_df(all_vars, function(var) {
  res <- pooled_results[[var]]
  if(is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  fam   <- get_family(var)
  p     <- res$p_val
  es    <- res$effect_size
  etype <- res$effect_type
  interp <- if(etype == "Cohens_d") interpret_d(es) else interpret_v(es)

  data.frame(
    variable       = var,
    Family         = fam,
    p_val          = p,
    effect_type    = etype,
    effect_size    = es,
    ci_low         = res$ci_low,
    ci_high        = res$ci_high,
    interpretation = interp,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# FDR correction within families
summary_rows <- summary_rows %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p_val, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

#==============================================================================
# BUILD DISPLAY TABLE
#==============================================================================

format_p <- function(p) {
  if(is.na(p)) return("")
  if(p < 0.001) return("< .001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

format_sig <- function(p) {
  if(is.na(p)) return("")
  if(p < 0.001) return("***")
  if(p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if(p < 0.05)  return("*")
  return("")
}

format_es <- function(etype, es, lo, hi) {
  if(is.na(es)) return("")
  if(etype == "Cohens_d")  return(sprintf("d = %+.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", es, lo, hi))
  if(etype == "Cramers_V") return(sprintf("V = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",  es, lo, hi))
  return("")
}

table_rows <- list()

for(var in all_vars) {
  res  <- pooled_results[[var]]
  srow <- summary_rows[summary_rows$variable == var, ]
  if(is.null(res) || nrow(srow) == 0) next

  fam <- srow$Family

  if(res$type == "continuous") {
    table_rows[[length(table_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Family       = fam,
      Variable     = var,
      is_subrow    = FALSE,
      Overall      = res$overall_desc,
      Continued    = res$cont_desc,
      Discontinued = res$disc_desc,
      p            = format_p(srow$p_val),
      p_FDR        = format_p(srow$p_fdr),
      Sig          = format_sig(srow$p_fdr),
      ES           = format_es(srow$effect_type, srow$effect_size, srow$ci_low, srow$ci_high),
      Interpretation = srow$interpretation,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    # Parent row (blank descriptives — stats at variable level)
    table_rows[[length(table_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Family       = fam,
      Variable     = var,
      is_subrow    = FALSE,
      Overall      = "",
      Continued    = "",
      Discontinued = "",
      p            = format_p(srow$p_val),
      p_FDR        = format_p(srow$p_fdr),
      Sig          = format_sig(srow$p_fdr),
      ES           = format_es(srow$effect_type, srow$effect_size, srow$ci_low, srow$ci_high),
      Interpretation = srow$interpretation,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    # Sub-rows for each level
    for(j in seq_len(nrow(res$levels))) {
      lv <- res$levels[j, ]
      table_rows[[length(table_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
        Family       = fam,
        Variable     = paste0("    ", lv$level),
        is_subrow    = TRUE,
        Overall      = lv$overall_desc,
        Continued    = lv$cont_desc,
        Discontinued = lv$disc_desc,
        p = "", p_FDR = "", Sig = "", ES = "", Interpretation = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

display_table <- bind_rows(table_rows) %>%
  select(Family, Variable, Overall, Continued, Discontinued,
         p, p_FDR, Sig, `Effect Size [95% CI]` = ES, Interpretation)
```
