```{r}
  filter(interpretation %in% c("Medium","Large")) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(effect_size)))

if(nrow(notable) > 0) {
  cat("NOTABLE EFFECT SIZES (medium or large, regardless of significance):\n")
  cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  print(notable %>%
          select(Family, variable, effect_type, effect_size, ci_low, ci_high, interpretation),
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}

#==============================================================================
# MANUSCRIPT TEXT SNIPPET
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("MANUSCRIPT TEXT SNIPPET\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

age_res <- pooled_results[["age"]]
cat("Sample Characteristics:\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
if(!is.null(age_res))
  cat(sprintf("The final sample comprised %d older adults (M age = %s years).\n",
              n_total, age_res$overall_desc))

sex_res <- pooled_results[["sex"]]
if(!is.null(sex_res)) {
  female_row <- sex_res$levels[sex_res$levels$level == "Female", ]
  if(nrow(female_row) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("The sample was %.1f%% female (n = %d).\n",
                female_row$overall_pct, female_row$overall_n))
}

cat(sprintf("\nOf the %d participants, %d (%.1f%%) reported discontinuing their\n",
            n_total, n_discontinued, 100*n_discontinued/n_total))
cat(sprintf("BZRA medication; %d (%.1f%%) continued use.\n\n",
            n_continued, 100*n_continued/n_total))

cat("Group Comparisons:\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
if(nrow(sig_vars) > 0) {
  cat("After FDR correction within variable families (Benjamini & Hochberg, 1995),\n")
  cat("those who discontinued differed significantly from those who continued\n")
  cat(sprintf("on %d variable(s):\n\n", nrow(sig_vars)))
  for(i in seq_len(min(5, nrow(sig_vars)))) {
    es_label <- ifelse(sig_vars$effect_type[i] == "Cohens_d", "d", "V")
    dir_note <- if(sig_vars$effect_type[i] == "Cohens_d" && sig_vars$effect_size[i] > 0) {
      "(higher in discontinued)"
    } else if(sig_vars$effect_type[i] == "Cohens_d") {
      "(lower in discontinued)"
    } else ""
    cat(sprintf("  %s: p_FDR = %.4f, %s = %.2f %s [%s]\n",
                sig_vars$variable[i], sig_vars$p_fdr[i],
                es_label, sig_vars$effect_size[i],
                dir_note, sig_vars$interpretation[i]))
  }
  if(nrow(sig_vars) > 5) cat("  ... and", nrow(sig_vars)-5, "more\n")
} else {
  cat("After FDR correction, no significant baseline differences were observed\n")
  cat("between those who discontinued and those who continued BZRA use.\n")
}

cat("\nStatistical Methods:\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("Descriptive statistics and group comparisons were computed across all\n"))
cat(sprintf("%d imputed datasets and pooled using Rubin's (1987) Rules.\n", m))
cat("For continuous variables, pooled means and within-imputation SDs are\n")
cat("reported. Group differences were tested using pooled t-statistics with\n")
cat("Barnard-Rubin degrees of freedom; effect sizes are Cohen's d computed\n")
cat("from pooled means and pooled within-group SDs (positive values indicate\n")
cat("higher scores in the discontinued group). For categorical variables,\n")
cat("pooled proportions are reported as n (%); group differences were tested\n")
cat("using the mean pooled chi-square statistic (Enders, 2010); effect sizes\n")
cat("are Cramer's V. FDR correction (Benjamini & Hochberg, 1995) was applied\n")
cat("within five variable families:\n")
cat(sprintf("demographics (k=%d), clinical (k=%d), sleep/adverse effects (k=%d),\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% demographics), sum(all_vars %in% clinical),
            sum(all_vars %in% sleep_adverse)))
cat(sprintf("behavioural (k=%d), and personality (k=%d).\n\n",
            sum(all_vars %in% behavioural), sum(all_vars %in% personality)))

#==============================================================================
# COMPLETE
#==============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n")
cat("CHUNK 10 COMPLETE\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")
cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. TABLE1_overall_characteristics.csv\n")
cat("  2. TABLE2_publication_ready_with_FDR.csv\n")
cat("  3. TABLE2_FDR_summary_by_family.csv\n")
if(nrow(sig_vars) > 0)
  cat("  4. TABLE2_significant_variables_FDR.csv\n")
cat("\nNOTES:\n")
cat("  - All estimates pooled across", m, "imputations (Rubin's Rules)\n")
cat("  - Continuous: Mean (pooled within-imputation SD)\n")
cat("  - Categorical: n (pooled %)\n")
cat("  - Cohen's d: positive = higher in discontinued group\n")
cat("  - Cramer's V: always positive\n")
cat("  - BFI subscales: 2-item Spearman-Brown, not true Cronbach's alpha\n")
cat("  - DBAS_Total included as overall dysfunctional beliefs summary\n\n")
cat("REFERENCES:\n")
cat("  Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.\n")
cat("  Li et al. (1991). Statistica Sinica, 1(1), 65-92.\n")
cat("  Enders, C.K. (2010). Applied Missing Data Analysis.\n")
cat("  Benjamini & Hochberg (1995). JRSS-B, 57(1), 289-300.\n")
cat("  Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical Power Analysis (2nd ed.).\n\n")
```






## PERS VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY PREDICTORS)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Select important personality variables for BZRA discontinuation using
#   VSURF applied separately to each of the 25 imputed datasets.
#   Variables are retained by majority vote (selected in ≥ 13/25 runs).
#
# Strategy (Option 1 — MI-appropriate):
#   Run VSURF independently on each imputed dataset.
#   Majority-vote separately for threshold, interpretation, and prediction sets.
#   Use the PREDICTION set for downstream logistic regression.
#
# Rationale for prediction set (not interpretation set):
#   The interpretation set maximises explanatory coverage; the prediction set
#   is the minimal subset that preserves predictive accuracy. With only 93
#   events (~6-9 EPV ceiling), parsimony is required.
#
# References:
#   Genuer R, Poggi J-M, Tuleau-Malot C (2015). VSURF: An R Package for
#     Variable Selection Using Random Forests. R Journal, 7(2):19-33.
#   Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (PERSONALITY)\n")
cat("MI-appropriate: majority vote across all 25 imputations\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!file.exists("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)
N           <- nrow(all_imputed[[1]])

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n\n", N))

outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERSONALITY VARIABLE SET
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PERSONALITY VARIABLE SET\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

personality_vars <- c(
  # BFI-10 (Big Five Inventory — 2 items per trait)
  "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",

  # SURPS (Substance Use Risk Profile Scale)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",

  # DBAS-16 subscales (dysfunctional beliefs about sleep)
  # DBAS_Total excluded: mean of all 16 items — collinear with subscales
  "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",

  # CISS (Coping Inventory for Stressful Situations)
  "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
)

cat(sprintf("Total personality variables: %d\n", length(personality_vars)))
cat("  BFI-10 (5): Extraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Neuroticism, Openness\n")
cat("  SURPS  (4): Impulsivity, Sensation_Seeking, Hopelessness, Anxiety_Sensitivity\n")
cat("  DBAS   (4): Consequences, Worry_Helplessness, Expectations, Medications\n")
cat("  CISS   (3): Task, Emotion, Avoidance\n")
cat("  DBAS_Total excluded (mean of all 16 items — collinear with subscales)\n\n")

# Confirm all variables present in first dataset
missing_vars <- personality_vars[!personality_vars %in% names(all_imputed[[1]])]
if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("✗ MISSING variables (check Chunk 9):\n")
  for(v in missing_vars) cat("  •", v, "\n")
  stop("Cannot proceed — personality subscales missing from imputed data.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("✓ All %d personality variables confirmed in imputed data\n\n",
              length(personality_vars)))
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EVENTS-PER-VARIABLE CHECK
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

n_events <- sum(all_imputed[[1]][[outcome_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
epv      <- round(n_events / length(personality_vars), 1)

cat("EPV CHECK:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Events (discontinuers): %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("  Input variables: %d\n", length(personality_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  Events-per-variable: %.1f\n", epv))
if(epv < 5)
  cat("  ⚠️  EPV < 5 — interpret VSURF results cautiously\n")
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY-VOTE VSURF ACROSS ALL m IMPUTATIONS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF ON ALL 25 IMPUTATIONS\n")
cat("(this will take several minutes)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

majority_threshold      <- ceiling(m / 2)   # ≥ 13 of 25 (threshold + interpretation sets)
majority_threshold_pred <- 10L               # ≥ 10 of 25 (prediction set only)
                                             # Rationale: VSURF prediction sets are
                                             # intentionally sparse; ≥10/25 captures
                                             # variables with consistent signal while
                                             # preserving parsimony for EPV constraints.
cat(sprintf("Majority-vote threshold (threshold/interp sets): ≥ %d / %d runs\n",
            majority_threshold, m))
cat(sprintf("Majority-vote threshold (prediction set):        ≥ %d / %d runs\n\n",
            majority_threshold_pred, m))

# Storage
thres_list  <- vector("list", m)   # threshold set per imputation
interp_list <- vector("list", m)   # interpretation set per imputation
pred_list   <- vector("list", m)   # prediction set per imputation
imp_list    <- vector("list", m)   # importance values per imputation
failed_runs <- integer(0)

start_time <- Sys.time()

for(i in seq_len(m)) {

  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %2d / %d ... ", i, m))

  df <- all_imputed[[i]]

  # Predictor matrix — personality vars only
  X <- as.data.frame(lapply(df[, personality_vars, drop = FALSE], as.numeric))

  # Outcome — numeric 0/1 → factor
  y <- factor(df[[outcome_var]], levels = c(0, 1),
              labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))

  # Drop any rows with NA outcome (should be none post-imputation)
  ok <- !is.na(y)
  X  <- X[ok, ]
  y  <- droplevels(y[ok])

  set.seed(12345 + i)   # reproducible but distinct per imputation

  vsurf_i <- tryCatch(
    VSURF(
      x       = X,
      y       = y,
      ntree   = 2000,
      mtry    = max(floor(ncol(X) / 3), 1),
      parallel = FALSE,
      verbose  = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("FAILED (%s)\n", e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if(is.null(vsurf_i)) {
    failed_runs <- c(failed_runs, i)
    thres_list[[i]]  <- character(0)
    interp_list[[i]] <- character(0)
    pred_list[[i]]   <- character(0)
    imp_list[[i]]    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(personality_vars)),
                                  personality_vars)
    next
  }

  thres_list[[i]]  <- personality_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.thres]
  interp_list[[i]] <- personality_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.interp]
  pred_list[[i]]   <- personality_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.pred]

  # Store mean importance across all variables (for later averaging)
  imp_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(personality_vars)), personality_vars)
  imp_vec[personality_vars] <- vsurf_i$imp.mean.dec
  imp_list[[i]] <- imp_vec

  n_thres <- length(thres_list[[i]])
  n_pred  <- length(pred_list[[i]])
  cat(sprintf("thres=%d, pred=%d\n", n_thres, n_pred))
}

end_time   <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)
cat(sprintf("\n✓ VSURF completed in %.1f minutes\n", time_taken))
if(length(failed_runs) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  Failed runs: %s\n", paste(failed_runs, collapse = ", ")))
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY VOTE
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MAJORITY-VOTE RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

count_selections <- function(sel_list, varnames) {
  counts <- setNames(integer(length(varnames)), varnames)
  for(s in sel_list) counts[intersect(s, varnames)] <- counts[intersect(s, varnames)] + 1L
  sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE)
}

thres_counts  <- count_selections(thres_list,  personality_vars)
interp_counts <- count_selections(interp_list, personality_vars)
pred_counts   <- count_selections(pred_list,   personality_vars)

# Variables meeting majority threshold
majority_thres  <- names(thres_counts[ thres_counts  >= majority_threshold])
majority_interp <- names(interp_counts[interp_counts >= majority_threshold])
majority_pred   <- names(pred_counts[  pred_counts   >= majority_threshold_pred])

# Average importance across successful runs
valid_imp   <- imp_list[!sapply(imp_list, function(x) all(is.na(x)))]
mean_imp    <- if(length(valid_imp) > 0) {
  imp_mat <- do.call(rbind, valid_imp)
  colMeans(imp_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
} else setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(personality_vars)), personality_vars)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable         = personality_vars,
  Mean_Importance  = mean_imp[personality_vars],
  Thres_Count      = thres_counts[personality_vars],
  Interp_Count     = interp_counts[personality_vars],
  Pred_Count       = pred_counts[personality_vars],
  Majority_Thres   = personality_vars %in% majority_thres,
  Majority_Interp  = personality_vars %in% majority_interp,
  Majority_Pred    = personality_vars %in% majority_pred,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(desc(Mean_Importance))

cat("SELECTION COUNTS (out of", m, "runs):\n\n")
print(importance_df %>%
        select(Variable, Mean_Importance, Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count),
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
cat("\n")

# Report majority sets
cat(sprintf("MAJORITY THRESHOLD SET  (≥%d/25): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, length(majority_thres)))
for(v in majority_thres) cat(sprintf("  • %s  (%d/25)\n", v, thres_counts[v]))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY INTERPRETATION SET (≥%d/25): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, length(majority_interp)))
for(v in majority_interp) cat(sprintf("  • %s  (%d/25)\n", v, interp_counts[v]))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY PREDICTION SET (≥%d/25): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold_pred, length(majority_pred)))
cat("→ USE THESE FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
for(v in majority_pred) cat(sprintf("  • %s  (%d/25)\n", v, pred_counts[v]))
cat("\n")

# EPV check on prediction set
if(length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  epv_pred <- round(n_events / length(majority_pred), 1)
  cat(sprintf("EPV with prediction set: %d events / %d predictors = %.1f\n",
              n_events, length(majority_pred), epv_pred))
  if(epv_pred >= 10)
    cat("✓ EPV ≥ 10 — adequate for logistic regression\n\n")
  else if(epv_pred >= 5)
    cat("~ EPV 5–9 — acceptable; interpret with caution\n\n")
  else
    cat("⚠️  EPV < 5 — consider further reduction before regression\n\n")
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DOMAIN BREAKDOWN
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SELECTION BY PERSONALITY DOMAIN\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

get_domain <- function(vars) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^BFI_",  vars) ~ "BFI",
    grepl("^SURPS_",vars) ~ "SURPS",
    grepl("^DBAS_", vars) ~ "DBAS",
    grepl("^CISS_", vars) ~ "CISS",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

domain_totals <- c(BFI = 5, SURPS = 4, DBAS = 4, CISS = 3)

if(length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  pred_domain_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = majority_pred,
    Domain   = get_domain(majority_pred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  domain_summary <- pred_domain_df %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(N_Total  = domain_totals[Domain],
           Pct      = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1))

  cat("Prediction set — by domain:\n")
  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables met majority threshold in prediction set.\n")
  cat("   Consider lowering threshold (e.g., ≥ 10/25) or reviewing VSURF output.\n\n")
  domain_summary <- data.frame()
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VISUALIZATION
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Creating visualizations...\n")

# Plot 1: Mean importance with selection counts
plot_data <- importance_df %>%
  mutate(
    Domain    = get_domain(Variable),
    In_Pred   = Majority_Pred,
    Var_Label = gsub("^(BFI|SURPS|DBAS|CISS)_", "", Variable)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(plot_data,
             aes(x    = reorder(Variable, Mean_Importance),
                 y    = Mean_Importance,
                 fill = Domain,
                 alpha = In_Pred)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d/25", Pred_Count)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.35),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "In majority prediction set",
                                "FALSE" = "Not selected"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Domain") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Variable Importance — Personality Predictors",
    subtitle = sprintf("VSURF majority vote across 25 imputations  |  prediction set: %d variables",
                       length(majority_pred)),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Mean Variable Importance (averaged across imputations)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave("VSURF_personality_importance.png", p1, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance.png\n")

# Plot 2: Selection stability heatmap (pred set counts per variable)
stability_data <- importance_df %>%
  select(Variable, Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Variable,
                      names_to  = "Step",
                      values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Step = factor(Step,
                       levels = c("Thres_Count", "Interp_Count", "Pred_Count"),
                       labels = c("Threshold", "Interpretation", "Prediction")),
         Variable = factor(Variable,
                           levels = importance_df$Variable[order(importance_df$Mean_Importance)]))

p2 <- ggplot(stability_data, aes(x = Step, y = Variable, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 3.2, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = length(personality_vars) - length(majority_pred) + 0.5,
             colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d9f0d3", high = "#1a7340",
                      limits = c(0, m), name = "Times\nselected") +
  labs(
    title    = "VSURF Selection Stability Across 25 Imputations",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line = majority threshold (%d/25)", majority_threshold),
    x        = "VSURF Step",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggsave("VSURF_personality_stability.png", p2, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_stability.png\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

vsurf_personality_output <- list(

  # FINAL SELECTIONS (majority vote)
  majority_pred    = majority_pred,      # ← USE FOR REGRESSION
  majority_interp  = majority_interp,
  majority_thres   = majority_thres,

  # Per-imputation raw selections
  pred_list        = pred_list,
  interp_list      = interp_list,
  thres_list       = thres_list,

  # Selection counts and importance
  importance_df    = importance_df,
  pred_counts      = pred_counts,
  interp_counts    = interp_counts,
  thres_counts     = thres_counts,

  # Domain summary
  domain_summary   = domain_summary,

  # Metadata
  metadata = list(
    input_vars              = personality_vars,
    outcome                 = outcome_var,
    m                       = m,
    N                       = N,
    n_events                = n_events,
    majority_threshold      = majority_threshold,       # ≥13/25 for thres + interp
    majority_threshold_pred = majority_threshold_pred,  # ≥10/25 for prediction set
    n_pred_selected         = length(majority_pred),
    n_interp_selected       = length(majority_interp),
    n_thres_selected        = length(majority_thres),
    failed_runs             = failed_runs,
    time_minutes            = as.numeric(time_taken),
    seed_base               = 12345
  )
)

saveRDS(vsurf_personality_output, "VSURF_personality_results.rds")
# Also save just the prediction set — loaded by regression chunk
saveRDS(majority_pred,            "VSURF_personality_selected.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_selected.rds\n\n")

write.csv(importance_df, "VSURF_personality_importance_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: VSURF_personality_importance_table.csv\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11A COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat(sprintf("VSURF ran on %d imputations (%d failed)\n",
            m, length(failed_runs)))
cat(sprintf("Majority threshold: ≥ %d / %d runs\n\n", majority_threshold, m))

cat("FINAL SELECTIONS:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Threshold set:      %d variables\n", length(majority_thres)))
cat(sprintf("  Interpretation set: %d variables\n", length(majority_interp)))
cat(sprintf("  Prediction set:     %d variables  ← FOR REGRESSION\n\n",
            length(majority_pred)))

if(length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  cat("PREDICTION SET VARIABLES:\n")
  for(i in seq_along(majority_pred))
    cat(sprintf("  %d. %s  (selected in %d/25 runs)\n",
                i, majority_pred[i], pred_counts[majority_pred[i]]))
  cat(sprintf("\n  EPV: %d / %d = %.1f\n",
              n_events, length(majority_pred),
              n_events / length(majority_pred)))
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables selected in prediction set.\n")
  cat("   Load VSURF_personality_results.rds and review pred_counts\n")
  cat("   to decide on a lower threshold (e.g., ≥ 10/25).\n")
}

cat("\n✓ Ready for Chunk 12A: logistic regression (personality model)\n\n")
```





## FULL VSURF
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (ALL PREDICTORS — FULL MODEL)
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Select important predictors of BZRA discontinuation from the full candidate
#   set, covering demographics, clinical, sleep/adverse effects, behavioural,
#   and personality domains.
#
# Strategy (Option 1 — MI-appropriate):
#   Run VSURF independently on each of the 25 imputed datasets.
#   Majority-vote: ≥13/25 for threshold and interpretation sets,
#                  ≥10/25 for prediction set (consistent with Chunk 11A).
#   Use the PREDICTION set for downstream logistic regression.
#
# On withdrawal variables:
#   stop_wdl_exp_combined excluded from this run.
#   wdl_symptom_count retained as a continuous count of prior withdrawal
#   symptoms — measured patient history, not concurrent outcome.
#
# On DBAS_Total:
#   Excluded — not used in any prior analysis chunk; only the four DBAS
#   subscales (Consequences, Worry_Helplessness, Expectations, Medications)
#   are carried forward here for consistency.
#
# References:
#   Genuer R, Poggi J-M, Tuleau-Malot C (2015). VSURF: An R Package for
#     Variable Selection Using Random Forests. R Journal, 7(2):19-33.
#   Rubin, D.B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#==============================================================================

library(VSURF)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 11B: VSURF VARIABLE SELECTION (FULL MODEL)\n")
cat("MI-appropriate: majority vote across all 25 imputations\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!file.exists("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

all_imputed <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
m           <- length(all_imputed)
N           <- nrow(all_imputed[[1]])

# Convenience alias for variable-availability checks
d1 <- all_imputed[[1]]

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n\n", N))

outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FULL CANDIDATE PREDICTOR SET
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FULL CANDIDATE PREDICTOR SET\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ── Demographics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
demographics <- c(
  "age", "sex", "education", "income", "employment",
  "driving_freq"
)

# ── Clinical ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clinical <- c(
  # Core health
  "phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant",
  "n_physical_conditions", "n_ment_conditions",
  "n_sleep_conditions", "n_health_conditions",
  # BZRA dose (weekly excluded — perfect collinearity with daily; see Chunk 7)
  "bzra_daily_diazepam_eq",
  # Length of BZRA use
  "c_lengthofuse",
  # Medication burden (4 separate items — no composite)
  "med_burden_1", "med_burden2", "medburden_3", "med_burden_4",
  # BMQ Necessity raw items (beliefs about medication necessity;
  # composite deferred post-imputation)
  "benefit_1", "benefit_4", "benefit_5", "benefit_6", "benefit_dep",
  # Stop rate (how quickly stopped: abruptly / slowly / very slowly)
  "stop_rate_dc",
  # Reasons for stopping / would stop (17 items; same scale, different framing
  # for current vs former users — coalesced in Chunk 5)
  "memory", "thinking", "activities", "socialize", "driving",
  "balance", "falls", "indication", "efficacy", "alternative",
  "inf_soc", "inf_pres", "inf_rphc", "interactions",
  "dependence", "reduc", "cost"
)

# ── Sleep / Adverse effects ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Withdrawal variables included: prior withdrawal history is measured patient
# history, not concurrent outcome. See header note.
sleep_adverse <- c(
  "alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep",
  paste0("side_effects_", 1:4),
  paste0("safety_", 1:4),
  paste0("adls_", 1:2),
  paste0("dependence_", 1:3),
  "wdl_symptom_count"
)

# ── Behavioural ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
behavioural <- c(
  # COM-B items only
  paste0("motivation_", 1:3),
  paste0("desires_", 1:3),
  "capability_1", "capability"
)

# ── Personality subscales ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DBAS_Total excluded — not used in any prior analysis chunk.
# Only the four DBAS subscales are included for consistency.
personality <- c(
  # BFI-10 (5 subscales — all 2-item; see note on Spearman-Brown reliability)
  "BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
  "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
  # SURPS (4 subscales)
  "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
  "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
  # DBAS-16 (4 subscales only)
  "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
  "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
  # CISS (3 subscales)
  "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance"
)

all_vars <- c(demographics, clinical, sleep_adverse, behavioural, personality)

# Remove any duplicates
all_vars <- unique(all_vars)

# Restrict to variables actually present in the imputed data
all_vars <- all_vars[all_vars %in% names(d1)]

# Report
cat(sprintf("Demographics   (%2d): %s\n",
            length(demographics),
            paste(demographics, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Clinical       (%2d): %s\n",
            length(clinical),
            paste(clinical, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Sleep/Adverse  (%2d): %s\n",
            length(sleep_adverse),
            paste(sleep_adverse, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Behavioural    (%2d): %s\n",
            length(behavioural),
            paste(behavioural, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Personality    (%2d): %s\n",
            length(personality),
            paste(personality, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("\nTotal candidate predictors (after availability check): %d\n",
            length(all_vars)))
cat("DBAS_Total excluded (not used in prior chunks)\n\n")

# Warn about any variables declared above but absent from data
all_declared <- unique(c(demographics, clinical, sleep_adverse,
                          behavioural, personality))
missing_vars  <- all_declared[!all_declared %in% names(d1)]
if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %d declared variables not found in data (excluded):\n",
              length(missing_vars)))
  for(v in missing_vars) cat("  •", v, "\n")
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("✓ All %d declared variables confirmed in imputed data\n\n",
              length(all_declared)))
}

# ── Domain lookup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_family <- function(var) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    var %in% demographics  ~ "Demographics",
    var %in% clinical      ~ "Clinical",
    var %in% sleep_adverse ~ "Sleep_Adverse",
    var %in% behavioural   ~ "Behavioural",
    var %in% personality   ~ "Personality",
    TRUE                   ~ "Other"
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CATEGORICAL vs CONTINUOUS VARIABLE LISTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat_vars <- c(
  "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq",
  "gen_health", "alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep",
  "stop_rate_dc"
)
cat_vars  <- cat_vars[cat_vars %in% names(d1)]
cont_vars <- all_vars[!all_vars %in% cat_vars]

cat(sprintf("Categorical variables (kept as factors): %d\n", length(cat_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  %s\n", paste(cat_vars, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Continuous/ordinal variables:            %d\n\n", length(cont_vars)))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EVENTS-PER-VARIABLE CHECK
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

n_events  <- sum(d1[[outcome_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
epv_input <- round(n_events / length(all_vars), 1)

cat("EPV CHECK (input variables):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Events (discontinuers): %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("  Input variables:        %d\n", length(all_vars)))
cat(sprintf("  EPV at input stage:     %.1f\n", epv_input))
cat("  Note: EPV constraint applies to the FINAL regression model,\n")
cat("  not to VSURF input. VSURF will reduce this to a feasible set.\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREPARE RECODE FUNCTION
# Apply consistent factor coding across all imputations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

recode_for_vsurf <- function(df) {

  if("sex" %in% names(df))
    df$sex <- factor(df$sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Female", "Male"))

  if("employment" %in% names(df)) {
    df$employment <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$employment %in% c(0, 3, 4) ~ "Not in Workforce",
      df$employment %in% c(1, 2)    ~ "Full- or Part-Time Work",
      TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$employment <- factor(df$employment,
      levels = c("Full- or Part-Time Work", "Not in Workforce"))
  }

  if("education" %in% names(df)) {
    df$education <- dplyr::case_when(
      df$education %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "High School or Less",
      df$education %in% c(4, 5)    ~ "Trade School/University Degree",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    )
    df$education <- factor(df$education,
      levels = c("High School or Less", "Trade School/University Degree"))
  }

  if("income" %in% names(df))
    df$income <- factor(df$income, levels = 1:5,
      labels = c("$15,000 or less", "$15,000 to $30,000", "$30,000 to $50,000",
                 "$50,000 to $80,000", "$80,000 or more"))

  if("driving_freq" %in% names(df))
    df$driving_freq <- factor(df$driving_freq, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Do not drive", "Less than 1 day/week",
                 "1-3 days/week", "4-7 days/week"))

  if("gen_health" %in% names(df)) {
    # gen_health may already be a character/factor with labels, or numeric codes.
    # Normalise to an ordered factor regardless of input format.
    gh_levels <- c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent")
    if(is.numeric(df$gen_health)) {
      df$gen_health <- factor(df$gen_health, levels = 1:5, labels = gh_levels,
                              ordered = TRUE)
    } else {
      df$gen_health <- factor(as.character(df$gen_health),
                              levels = gh_levels, ordered = TRUE)
    }
  }

  # Sleep-aid frequency: 0 = never (not used), 1–4 = frequency categories.
  # 0 is a valid imputed value meaning the participant does not use that aid.
  sleep_freq_labels <- c("Never", "Less than 1 day/week", "1-3 days/week",
                         "4-6 days/week", "7 days/week")
  for(sv in c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep"))
    if(sv %in% names(df))
      df[[sv]] <- factor(df[[sv]], levels = 0:4, labels = sleep_freq_labels)

  if("stop_rate_dc" %in% names(df))
    df$stop_rate_dc <- factor(df$stop_rate_dc, levels = 0:2,
      labels = c("Abruptly (cold turkey)",
                 "Slowly (1-4 weeks)",
                 "Very slowly (>4 weeks)"),
      ordered = TRUE)

  # Likert scales to numeric
  likert_vars <- c(
    paste0("side_effects_", 1:4), paste0("safety_", 1:4),
    paste0("adls_", 1:2), paste0("dependence_", 1:3),
    "med_burden_1", "med_burden2", "medburden_3", "med_burden_4",
    "benefit_1", "benefit_4", "benefit_5", "benefit_6", "benefit_dep",
    "memory", "thinking", "activities", "socialize", "driving",
    "balance", "falls", "indication", "efficacy", "alternative",
    "inf_soc", "inf_pres", "inf_rphc", "interactions",
    "dependence", "reduc", "cost"
  )
  for(var in likert_vars)
    if(var %in% names(df) && !is.numeric(df[[var]]))
      df[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df[[var]]))

  df
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PRE-LOOP NA DIAGNOSTIC
# Runs recode_for_vsurf() on imputation 1 and reports any NAs introduced.
# Since the data are fully imputed, any NAs here are created by recoding
# (e.g. a numeric code not matched by a case_when branch).
# Fix the reported variables in recode_for_vsurf() before proceeding.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PRE-LOOP NA DIAGNOSTIC (imputation 1)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

diag_df   <- recode_for_vsurf(all_imputed[[1]])
diag_X    <- diag_df[, all_vars, drop = FALSE]
na_report <- sapply(diag_X, function(col) sum(is.na(col)))
na_report <- na_report[na_report > 0]

if(length(na_report) == 0) {
  cat("✓ No NAs after recoding — data are clean.\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %d variable(s) have NAs after recoding:\n\n", length(na_report)))
  for(v in names(na_report)) {
    raw_vals <- sort(unique(all_imputed[[1]][[v]]))
    cat(sprintf("  %-30s  NAs: %d   Raw values in data: %s\n",
                v, na_report[v], paste(head(raw_vals, 20), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat("\n")
  cat("ACTION REQUIRED: Update recode_for_vsurf() so all observed values\n")
  cat("are matched. Then re-run this chunk.\n\n")
  stop("Stopping — fix NA-producing recodes before running VSURF.")
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY-VOTE VSURF ACROSS ALL m IMPUTATIONS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("RUNNING VSURF ON ALL 25 IMPUTATIONS\n")
cat("(this will take longer than 11A — expect 20-40 minutes)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

majority_threshold      <- ceiling(m / 2)   # ≥ 13/25 for threshold + interp
majority_threshold_pred <- 10L               # ≥ 10/25 for prediction set

cat(sprintf("Majority-vote threshold (threshold/interp sets): ≥ %d / %d runs\n",
            majority_threshold, m))
cat(sprintf("Majority-vote threshold (prediction set):        ≥ %d / %d runs\n\n",
            majority_threshold_pred, m))

# Storage
thres_list  <- vector("list", m)
interp_list <- vector("list", m)
pred_list   <- vector("list", m)
imp_list    <- vector("list", m)
failed_runs <- integer(0)

start_time <- Sys.time()

for(i in seq_len(m)) {

  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %2d / %d ... ", i, m))

  df <- recode_for_vsurf(all_imputed[[i]])

  # Build predictor matrix — only confirmed available variables
  X <- df[, all_vars, drop = FALSE]

  # Ensure factor columns are properly encoded (drop unused levels)
  for(v in cat_vars) {
    if(v %in% names(X) && is.factor(X[[v]]))
      X[[v]] <- droplevels(X[[v]])
  }

  # Convert non-factor, non-numeric columns to numeric
  for(v in names(X)) {
    if(!is.factor(X[[v]]) && !is.numeric(X[[v]]))
      X[[v]] <- as.numeric(as.character(X[[v]]))
  }

  X <- as.data.frame(X)

  # Outcome
  y  <- factor(df[[outcome_var]], levels = c(0, 1),
               labels = c("Continued", "Discontinued"))
  ok <- !is.na(y)
  X  <- X[ok, ]
  y  <- droplevels(y[ok])

  set.seed(12345 + i)

  vsurf_i <- tryCatch(
    VSURF(
      x        = X,
      y        = y,
      ntree    = 2000,
      mtry     = max(floor(sqrt(ncol(X))), 1),  # sqrt rule for classification
      parallel = FALSE,
      verbose  = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("FAILED (%s)\n", e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if(is.null(vsurf_i)) {
    failed_runs      <- c(failed_runs, i)
    thres_list[[i]]  <- character(0)
    interp_list[[i]] <- character(0)
    pred_list[[i]]   <- character(0)
    imp_list[[i]]    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_vars)), all_vars)
    next
  }

  thres_list[[i]]  <- all_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.thres]
  interp_list[[i]] <- all_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.interp]
  pred_list[[i]]   <- all_vars[vsurf_i$varselect.pred]

  imp_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_vars)), all_vars)
  imp_vec[all_vars] <- vsurf_i$imp.mean.dec
  imp_list[[i]] <- imp_vec

  n_thres <- length(thres_list[[i]])
  n_pred  <- length(pred_list[[i]])
  cat(sprintf("thres=%d, pred=%d\n", n_thres, n_pred))
}

end_time   <- Sys.time()
time_taken <- round(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"), 2)
cat(sprintf("\n✓ VSURF completed in %.1f minutes\n", time_taken))
if(length(failed_runs) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  Failed runs: %s\n", paste(failed_runs, collapse = ", ")))
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAJORITY VOTE
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MAJORITY-VOTE RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

count_selections <- function(sel_list, varnames) {
  counts <- setNames(integer(length(varnames)), varnames)
  for(s in sel_list)
    counts[intersect(s, varnames)] <- counts[intersect(s, varnames)] + 1L
  sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE)
}

thres_counts  <- count_selections(thres_list,  all_vars)
interp_counts <- count_selections(interp_list, all_vars)
pred_counts   <- count_selections(pred_list,   all_vars)

majority_thres  <- names(thres_counts[ thres_counts  >= majority_threshold])
majority_interp <- names(interp_counts[interp_counts >= majority_threshold])
majority_pred   <- names(pred_counts[  pred_counts   >= majority_threshold_pred])

# Average importance
valid_imp <- imp_list[!sapply(imp_list, function(x) all(is.na(x)))]
mean_imp  <- if(length(valid_imp) > 0) {
  imp_mat <- do.call(rbind, valid_imp)
  colMeans(imp_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
} else setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_vars)), all_vars)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable        = all_vars,
  Domain          = get_family(all_vars),
  Mean_Importance = mean_imp[all_vars],
  Thres_Count     = as.integer(thres_counts[all_vars]),
  Interp_Count    = as.integer(interp_counts[all_vars]),
  Pred_Count      = as.integer(pred_counts[all_vars]),
  Majority_Thres  = all_vars %in% majority_thres,
  Majority_Interp = all_vars %in% majority_interp,
  Majority_Pred   = all_vars %in% majority_pred,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(desc(Mean_Importance))

cat("SELECTION COUNTS (out of", m, "runs) — sorted by mean importance:\n\n")
print(importance_df %>%
        select(Variable, Domain, Mean_Importance,
               Thres_Count, Interp_Count, Pred_Count),
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
cat("\n")

# Report sets
cat(sprintf("MAJORITY THRESHOLD SET  (≥%d/25): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, length(majority_thres)))
for(v in majority_thres)
  cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/25)  [%s]\n",
              v, thres_counts[v], get_family(v)))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY INTERPRETATION SET (≥%d/25): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold, length(majority_interp)))
for(v in majority_interp)
  cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/25)  [%s]\n",
              v, interp_counts[v], get_family(v)))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("MAJORITY PREDICTION SET (≥%d/25): %d variables\n",
            majority_threshold_pred, length(majority_pred)))
cat("→ USE THESE FOR LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
for(v in majority_pred)
  cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/25)  [%s]\n",
              v, pred_counts[v], get_family(v)))
cat("\n")

# EPV check
if(length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  epv_pred <- round(n_events / length(majority_pred), 1)
  cat(sprintf("EPV with prediction set: %d events / %d predictors = %.1f\n",
              n_events, length(majority_pred), epv_pred))
  if(epv_pred >= 10)
    cat("✓ EPV ≥ 10 — adequate for logistic regression\n\n")
  else if(epv_pred >= 5)
    cat("~ EPV 5–9 — acceptable; interpret with caution\n\n")
  else
    cat("⚠️  EPV < 5 — consider raising the threshold before regression\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No variables met the prediction threshold.\n")
  cat("   Review pred_counts in the saved RDS.\n\n")
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DOMAIN BREAKDOWN OF PREDICTION SET
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PREDICTION SET — BY DOMAIN\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

domain_totals <- c(
  Demographics  = length(demographics),
  Clinical      = length(clinical),
  Sleep_Adverse = length(sleep_adverse),
  Behavioural   = length(behavioural),
  Personality   = length(personality)
)

if(length(majority_pred) > 0) {
  pred_domain_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = majority_pred,
    Domain   = get_family(majority_pred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  domain_summary <- pred_domain_df %>%
    count(Domain, name = "N_Selected") %>%
    mutate(N_Total = domain_totals[Domain],
           Pct     = round(100 * N_Selected / N_Total, 1)) %>%
    arrange(desc(N_Selected))

  print(domain_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")

  cat("Prediction set variables by domain:\n\n")
  for(dom in domain_summary$Domain) {
    vars_in <- pred_domain_df$Variable[pred_domain_df$Domain == dom]
    cat(sprintf("%s (%d):\n", dom, length(vars_in)))
    for(v in vars_in)
      cat(sprintf("  • %-35s (%d/25)\n", v, pred_counts[v]))
    cat("\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Prediction set is empty.\n\n")
  domain_summary <- data.frame()
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPARE WITH PERSONALITY-ONLY MODEL (11A)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("COMPARISON WITH PERSONALITY-ONLY MODEL (CHUNK 11A)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(file.exists("VSURF_personality_selected.rds")) {
```

## LR
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 12: LOGISTIC REGRESSION — PERSONALITY vs FULL MODEL + DELONG'S TEST
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Fit two logistic regression models using VSURF prediction sets:
#     Model A — Personality-only predictors (from Chunk 11A)
#     Model B — Full predictor set (from Chunk 11B)
#   Compare discriminative ability using DeLong's test.
#
# Models:
#   Model A: VSURF interpretation set — personality domain only
#   Model B: VSURF prediction set — full candidate set (all domains)
#
# AUC:
#   Calculated per imputation, averaged across imputations (Rubin's rules
#   are not directly applicable to AUC, so mean ± pooled CI is reported).
#   Bootstrap CIs (B = 2000) within each imputation.
#
# DeLong's test:
#   Applied per imputation on the same predicted probabilities used for AUC.
#   The resulting z-statistics and p-values are pooled using Rubin's rules
#   on the z-scale (following Li & Fine, 2010).
#
# References:
#   DeLong ER, DeLong DM, Clarke-Pearson DL (1988). Biometrics, 44:837-845.
#   Li J, Fine JP (2010). Comparing two AUCs with a MI dataset. Biostatistics.
#   Rubin DB (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(pROC)
library(broom)
library(car)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 12: LOGISTIC REGRESSION + DELONG'S TEST\n")
cat("Personality (11A) vs Full model (11B)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND VSURF RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART A: Loading data and VSURF results\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# ── Imputed data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if(!file.exists("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

imputed_list <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
m            <- length(imputed_list)
N            <- nrow(imputed_list[[1]])

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations (m): %d\n", m))
cat(sprintf("  Observations (N): %d\n\n", N))

# ── VSURF personality results (Chunk 11A) ─────────────────────────────────────
if(!file.exists("VSURF_personality_results.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: VSURF_personality_results.rds not found. Run Chunk 11A first.")

vsurf_pers <- readRDS("VSURF_personality_results.rds")

# ── VSURF full results (Chunk 11B) ────────────────────────────────────────────
if(!file.exists("VSURF_full_results.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: VSURF_full_results.rds not found. Run Chunk 11B first.")

vsurf_full <- readRDS("VSURF_full_results.rds")

# ── Outcome ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"
n_events    <- sum(imputed_list[[1]][[outcome_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Outcome: %s\n", outcome_var))
cat(sprintf("Events:  %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n\n", n_events, N,
            100 * n_events / N))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: DEFINE VARIABLE SETS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART B: Defining variable sets\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Model A uses the INTERPRETATION set (Step 2) from the personality VSURF.
# The interpretation set retains all variables useful for understanding the
# outcome, making it more appropriate than the prediction set (Step 3) when
# the prediction set is very small (e.g. 1 variable), as a single-predictor
# model is not a meaningful representation of the personality domain.
#
# Model B uses the PREDICTION set (Step 3) from the full VSURF, which is
# the most parsimonious data-driven set for optimal predictive accuracy.
vars_A <- vsurf_pers$majority_interp  # personality — interpretation set (Step 2)
vars_B <- vsurf_full$majority_pred    # full candidate set — prediction set (Step 3)

# Guard: if interpretation set is also empty, fall back to prediction set
if(length(vars_A) == 0) {
  cat("\u26a0\ufe0f  Model A: interpretation set empty — falling back to prediction set.\n\n")
  vars_A <- vsurf_pers$majority_pred
}
if(length(vars_A) == 0)
  stop("Model A: both interpretation and prediction sets are empty. Review Chunk 11A.")
if(length(vars_B) == 0)
  stop("Model B: VSURF full prediction set is empty. Review Chunk 11B.")

cat(sprintf("Model A — Personality VSURF interpretation set (%d variables):\n",
            length(vars_A)))
for(v in vars_A) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("Model B — Full VSURF prediction set (%d variables):\n",
            length(vars_B)))
for(v in vars_B) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

# Confirm all variables are present in the imputed data
check_vars <- function(vars, label) {
  missing <- vars[!vars %in% names(imputed_list[[1]])]
  if(length(missing) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s: %d variables not found in data:\n", label, length(missing)))
    for(v in missing) cat(sprintf("     • %s\n", v))
    stop("Fix missing variables before proceeding.")
  }
}
check_vars(vars_A, "Model A")
check_vars(vars_B, "Model B")
cat("✓ All predictor variables confirmed in imputed data\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: EPV CHECK
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART C: EPV check\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

epv_A <- round(n_events / length(vars_A), 1)
epv_B <- round(n_events / length(vars_B), 1)

epv_status <- function(epv) {
  if(epv >= 10) "✓ Adequate (≥10)"
  else if(epv >= 5) "~ Borderline (5–9)"
  else "⚠️  Low (<5)"
}

cat(sprintf("Model A: %d events / %d predictors = EPV %.1f  %s\n",
            n_events, length(vars_A), epv_A, epv_status(epv_A)))
cat(sprintf("Model B: %d events / %d predictors = EPV %.1f  %s\n\n",
            n_events, length(vars_B), epv_B, epv_status(epv_B)))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: FIT MODELS ACROSS ALL IMPUTATIONS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: Fitting models across all imputations\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

formula_A <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_A, collapse = " + ")))
formula_B <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_B, collapse = " + ")))

cat(sprintf("Formula A: %s\n\n", deparse(formula_A)))
cat(sprintf("Formula B: %s\n\n", deparse(formula_B)))

fit_models <- function(imputed_list, formula_obj, label) {
  m     <- length(imputed_list)
  fits  <- vector("list", m)
  fails <- integer(0)

  for(i in seq_len(m)) {
    fits[[i]] <- tryCatch(
      glm(formula_obj, data = imputed_list[[i]], family = binomial()),
      error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("  %s imputation %d FAILED: %s\n", label, i, e$message))
        fails <<- c(fails, i)
        NULL
      }
    )
  }

  if(length(fails) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("⚠️  %s: %d failed imputations: %s\n",
                label, length(fails), paste(fails, collapse = ", ")))

  structure(fits, class = c("mira", "matrix"))
}

cat("Fitting Model A (personality)...\n")
fits_A <- fit_models(imputed_list, formula_A, "Model A")
cat("✓ Model A fitted\n\n")

cat("Fitting Model B (full)...\n")
fits_B <- fit_models(imputed_list, formula_B, "Model B")
cat("✓ Model B fitted\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: POOL COEFFICIENTS (RUBIN'S RULES)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART E: Pooling coefficients\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

pool_and_summarise <- function(fits_mira, model_label) {
  pooled <- pool(fits_mira)
  smry   <- summary(pooled, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(`2.5 %`),
      OR_upper = exp(`97.5 %`),
      OR_CI    = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
      sig      = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p.value < 0.10  ~ ".",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      model = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, term, estimate, std.error, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper,
           OR_CI, statistic, p.value, sig)
  list(pooled = pooled, summary = smry)
}

results_A <- pool_and_summarise(fits_A, "Model A (Personality)")
results_B <- pool_and_summarise(fits_B, "Model B (Full)")

cat("MODEL A — Pooled coefficients:\n")
print(results_A$summary %>% select(term, OR_CI, p.value, sig), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

cat("MODEL B — Pooled coefficients:\n")
print(results_B$summary %>% select(term, OR_CI, p.value, sig), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: AUC WITH BOOTSTRAP CIs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: AUC per imputation (bootstrap CIs, B = 2000)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

calc_auc_mi <- function(fits_mira, imputed_list, label, boot.n = 2000) {

  m      <- length(imputed_list)
  aucs   <- numeric(m)
  lowers <- numeric(m)
  uppers <- numeric(m)

  for(i in seq_len(m)) {
    if(is.null(fits_mira[[i]])) {
      aucs[i] <- lowers[i] <- uppers[i] <- NA_real_
      next
    }
    pred_i <- predict(fits_mira[[i]], type = "response")
    roc_i  <- roc(imputed_list[[i]][[outcome_var]], pred_i, quiet = TRUE)
    aucs[i] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_i))
    ci_i   <- ci.auc(roc_i, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot.n)
    lowers[i] <- ci_i[1]
    uppers[i] <- ci_i[3]
  }

  cat(sprintf("%s AUC per imputation: %s\n", label,
              paste(sprintf("%.3f", aucs), collapse = ", ")))

  data.frame(
    model     = label,
    AUC_mean  = mean(aucs,   na.rm = TRUE),
    AUC_lower = mean(lowers, na.rm = TRUE),
    AUC_upper = mean(uppers, na.rm = TRUE),
    AUC_formatted = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
                            mean(aucs,   na.rm = TRUE),
                            mean(lowers, na.rm = TRUE),
                            mean(uppers, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

set.seed(42)
auc_A <- calc_auc_mi(fits_A, imputed_list, "Model A (Personality)")
auc_B <- calc_auc_mi(fits_B, imputed_list, "Model B (Full)")

cat("\n")
cat("AUC SUMMARY:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Model A (Personality): %s\n", auc_A$AUC_formatted))
cat(sprintf("  Model B (Full):        %s\n\n", auc_B$AUC_formatted))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: DELONG'S TEST (POOLED ACROSS IMPUTATIONS)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: DeLong's test — pooled across imputations\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Method: DeLong's test applied per imputation; z-statistics pooled\n")
cat("using Rubin's rules on the z-scale (Li & Fine, 2010).\n\n")

delong_results <- vector("list", m)

for(i in seq_len(m)) {

  if(is.null(fits_A[[i]]) || is.null(fits_B[[i]])) {
    delong_results[[i]] <- list(z = NA_real_, var = NA_real_, p = NA_real_)
    next
  }

  pred_A_i <- predict(fits_A[[i]], type = "response")
  pred_B_i <- predict(fits_B[[i]], type = "response")
  outcome_i <- imputed_list[[i]][[outcome_var]]

  roc_A_i <- roc(outcome_i, pred_A_i, quiet = TRUE)
  roc_B_i <- roc(outcome_i, pred_B_i, quiet = TRUE)

  test_i <- roc.test(roc_A_i, roc_B_i, method = "delong", paired = TRUE)

  # Store z-statistic and its variance (se^2) for Rubin pooling
  z_i <- test_i$statistic
  # pROC returns a named z; extract as numeric
  z_i <- as.numeric(z_i)
  # Approximate SE from the two-sided p-value via the normal distribution
  # (more stable than extracting directly from pROC internals)
  se_i <- as.numeric(test_i$statistic) /
            qnorm(1 - test_i$p.value / 2, lower.tail = TRUE)
  # Guard against numerical issues when p ~ 0
  if(!is.finite(se_i) || se_i == 0) se_i <- 1e-6

  delong_results[[i]] <- list(
    z   = z_i,
    var = se_i^2,
    p   = test_i$p.value,
    auc_A = as.numeric(auc(roc_A_i)),
    auc_B = as.numeric(auc(roc_B_i)),
    delta = as.numeric(auc(roc_B_i)) - as.numeric(auc(roc_A_i))
  )

  cat(sprintf("  Imputation %2d: AUC_A=%.3f  AUC_B=%.3f  Δ=%.3f  z=%.3f  p=%.4f\n",
              i,
              delong_results[[i]]$auc_A,
              delong_results[[i]]$auc_B,
              delong_results[[i]]$delta,
              delong_results[[i]]$z,
              delong_results[[i]]$p))
}

# ── Pool z-statistics using Rubin's rules ─────────────────────────────────────
valid_idx <- which(!sapply(delong_results, function(r) is.na(r$z)))
m_valid   <- length(valid_idx)

z_vec   <- sapply(delong_results[valid_idx], `[[`, "z")
var_vec <- sapply(delong_results[valid_idx], `[[`, "var")
delta_vec <- sapply(delong_results[valid_idx], `[[`, "delta")

# Rubin's rules
Q_bar  <- mean(z_vec)                          # pooled z
U_bar  <- mean(var_vec)                        # within-imputation variance
B      <- var(z_vec)                           # between-imputation variance
T_var  <- U_bar + (1 + 1/m_valid) * B         # total variance
z_pool <- Q_bar / sqrt(T_var)
p_pool <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_pool))

# Degrees of freedom (Barnard & Rubin, 1999)
r_L    <- (1 + 1/m_valid) * B / U_bar
df_old <- (m_valid - 1) / r_L^2
# Complete-data df approximation (large sample, so use normal)
# Report both p-value from normal and from t(df_old) for transparency
p_pool_t <- 2 * pt(-abs(z_pool), df = df_old)

mean_delta <- mean(delta_vec)

cat(sprintf("\n─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n"))
cat(sprintf("POOLED DELONG'S TEST (Rubin's rules, m=%d imputations)\n\n", m_valid))
cat(sprintf("  Mean ΔAUC (B − A):    %+.4f\n", mean_delta))
cat(sprintf("  Pooled z-statistic:   %.4f\n",  z_pool))
cat(sprintf("  p-value (normal):     %.4f%s\n", p_pool,
            ifelse(p_pool < 0.05, "  ← significant", "")))
cat(sprintf("  p-value (t, df=%.1f): %.4f\n", df_old, p_pool_t))
cat(sprintf("  Fraction missing info (λ): %.3f\n",
            (r_L + 2/(df_old + 3)) / (r_L + 1)))

if(p_pool < 0.05) {
  winner <- ifelse(mean_delta > 0, "Model B (Full)", "Model A (Personality)")
  cat(sprintf("\n  ✓ Significant difference: %s has higher AUC.\n", winner))
} else {
  cat("\n  Models do not differ significantly in AUC.\n")
}
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART H: DIAGNOSTICS (VIF + INFLUENTIAL CASES)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART H: Diagnostics (imputation 1)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

run_diagnostics <- function(formula_obj, data, label) {
  cat(sprintf("%s\n", label))
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

  fit <- glm(formula_obj, data = data, family = binomial())

  # VIF
  tryCatch({
    vif_vals <- vif(fit)
    if(is.matrix(vif_vals)) {
      vif_df <- data.frame(
        Variable = rownames(vif_vals),
        VIF      = vif_vals[, "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))"]
      )
    } else {
      vif_df <- data.frame(Variable = names(vif_vals), VIF = as.numeric(vif_vals))
    }
    vif_df <- vif_df %>% arrange(desc(VIF))
    max_vif <- max(vif_df$VIF)
    cat("VIF:\n")
    print(vif_df, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
    cat(sprintf("Max VIF: %.2f  %s\n\n", max_vif,
                ifelse(max_vif < 5, "(OK)", "(⚠️  >5)")))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("VIF could not be computed: %s\n\n", e$message))
  })

  # Cook's distance
  cooksd    <- cooks.distance(fit)
  threshold <- 4 / nrow(data)
  n_inf     <- sum(cooksd > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Cook's distance threshold: %.5f\n", threshold))
  cat(sprintf("Influential cases:         %d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
              n_inf, 100 * n_inf / nrow(data)))

  invisible(fit)
}

run_diagnostics(formula_A, imputed_list[[1]], "MODEL A — Personality")
run_diagnostics(formula_B, imputed_list[[1]], "MODEL B — Full")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

)

print(performance, row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\nDeLong's test (pooled): z = %.3f,  p = %.4f,  ΔAUC = %+.4f\n\n",
            z_pool, p_pool, mean_delta))

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART J: SAVE RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```

## Cross-Validation
```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 13: 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION — PERSONALITY vs FULL MODEL
#==============================================================================
# Purpose:
#   Internal validation of both logistic regression models from Chunk 12
#   using 10-fold cross-validation across all 25 imputations.
#
# Models:
#   Model A — Personality VSURF interpretation set (Chunk 11A)
#   Model B — Full VSURF prediction set (Chunk 11B)
#
# Method:
#   CV performed independently on each imputation; results pooled by
#   averaging across imputations (consistent with AUC pooling in Chunk 12).
#   Bootstrap CIs (B = 2000) on the overall out-of-fold AUC per imputation.
#
# Optimism:
#   Apparent AUC loaded directly from regression_comparison_results.rds
#   (guarantees exact match with Chunk 12 — no resampling drift).
#   Optimism = Apparent AUC − CV AUC.
#
# References:
#   Steyerberg EW (2009). Clinical Prediction Models. Springer.
#   Rubin DB (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys.
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CHUNK 13: 10-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION\n")
cat("Model A (Personality) vs Model B (Full)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART A: Loading data and Chunk 12 results\n")
cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# ── Imputed data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if(!file.exists("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds not found. Run Chunk 9 first.")

imputed_list <- readRDS("imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
m            <- length(imputed_list)
N            <- nrow(imputed_list[[1]])

cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Imputations: %d  |  N: %d\n\n", m, N))

# ── Chunk 12 regression results ───────────────────────────────────────────────
if(!file.exists("regression_comparison_results.rds"))
  stop("ERROR: regression_comparison_results.rds not found. Run Chunk 12 first.")

chunk12 <- readRDS("regression_comparison_results.rds")

vars_A      <- chunk12$variables$model_A
vars_B      <- chunk12$variables$model_B
outcome_var <- chunk12$metadata$outcome

# Apparent AUC values (loaded directly — no resampling)
apparent_auc_A <- chunk12$auc$model_A$AUC_mean
apparent_lower_A <- chunk12$auc$model_A$AUC_lower
apparent_upper_A <- chunk12$auc$model_A$AUC_upper

apparent_auc_B <- chunk12$auc$model_B$AUC_mean
apparent_lower_B <- chunk12$auc$model_B$AUC_lower
apparent_upper_B <- chunk12$auc$model_B$AUC_upper

cat(sprintf("Outcome: %s\n\n", outcome_var))

cat(sprintf("Model A — Personality interpretation set (%d variables):\n",
            length(vars_A)))
for(v in vars_A) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat(sprintf("Model B — Full prediction set (%d variables):\n",
            length(vars_B)))
for(v in vars_B) cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", v))
cat("\n")

cat("Apparent AUC (from Chunk 12):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Model A: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
            apparent_auc_A, apparent_lower_A, apparent_upper_A))
cat(sprintf("  Model B: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n",
            apparent_auc_B, apparent_lower_B, apparent_upper_B))

formula_A <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_A, collapse = " + ")))
formula_B <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(vars_B, collapse = " + ")))

boot.n   <- 2000
n_folds  <- 10

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: CV FUNCTION
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cv_one_imputation <- function(data, formula_obj, outcome_var,
                               n_folds = 10, seed = 123, boot.n = 2000) {

  set.seed(seed)
  n        <- nrow(data)
  fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = n))

  all_preds <- numeric(n)
  all_obs   <- numeric(n)
  fold_aucs <- numeric(n_folds)

  for(k in seq_len(n_folds)) {
    train_data <- data[fold_ids != k, ]
    test_data  <- data[fold_ids == k, ]

    model_k <- glm(formula_obj, data = train_data, family = binomial())
    pred_k  <- predict(model_k, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

    all_preds[fold_ids == k] <- pred_k
    all_obs[fold_ids == k]   <- test_data[[outcome_var]]

    roc_k        <- roc(test_data[[outcome_var]], pred_k, quiet = TRUE)
    fold_aucs[k] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_k))
  }

  # Overall CV AUC from concatenated out-of-fold predictions
  roc_overall <- roc(all_obs, all_preds, quiet = TRUE)
  overall_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_overall))

  # Bootstrap CI on overall CV AUC
  set.seed(seed + 1000)
  ci_overall <- ci.auc(roc_overall, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot.n)

  list(
    overall_auc   = overall_auc,
    cv_lower      = as.numeric(ci_overall[1]),
    cv_upper      = as.numeric(ci_overall[3]),
    fold_aucs     = fold_aucs,
    mean_fold_auc = mean(fold_aucs),
    sd_fold_auc   = sd(fold_aucs)
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: RUN CV FOR BOTH MODELS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat(sprintf("PART C: Running %d-fold CV across %d imputations\n", n_folds, m))
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

run_cv_all_imputations <- function(imputed_list, formula_obj, outcome_var,
                                    label, n_folds = 10, boot.n = 2000) {
  m       <- length(imputed_list)
  results <- vector("list", m)

  cat(sprintf("Running CV for %s...\n", label))
  for(i in seq_len(m)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Imputation %2d / %d\r", i, m))
    results[[i]] <- cv_one_imputation(
      data        = imputed_list[[i]],
      formula_obj = formula_obj,
      outcome_var = outcome_var,
      n_folds     = n_folds,
      seed        = 123 + i,
      boot.n      = boot.n
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf("✓ %s CV complete                    \n\n", label))
  results
}

cv_results_A <- run_cv_all_imputations(imputed_list, formula_A,
                                        outcome_var, "Model A (Personality)")
cv_results_B <- run_cv_all_imputations(imputed_list, formula_B,
                                        outcome_var, "Model B (Full)")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: POOL CV RESULTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: Pooled CV results\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

pool_cv <- function(cv_results_list, apparent_mean, apparent_lower,
                    apparent_upper, label) {

  cv_aucs   <- sapply(cv_results_list, `[[`, "overall_auc")
  cv_lowers <- sapply(cv_results_list, `[[`, "cv_lower")
  cv_uppers <- sapply(cv_results_list, `[[`, "cv_upper")

  cv_mean  <- mean(cv_aucs)
  cv_lower <- mean(cv_lowers)
  cv_upper <- mean(cv_uppers)
  optimism <- apparent_mean - cv_mean

  cat(sprintf("%s\n", label))
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Apparent AUC: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]  (from Chunk 12)\n",
              apparent_mean, apparent_lower, apparent_upper))
  cat(sprintf("  CV AUC:       %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\n", cv_mean, cv_lower, cv_upper))
  cat(sprintf("  Optimism:     %.3f\n", optimism))
  cat(sprintf("  CV AUC range: %.4f – %.4f\n", min(cv_aucs), max(cv_aucs)))
  cat(sprintf("  CV AUC SD:    %.4f\n", sd(cv_aucs)))

  # Interpret optimism
  interp <- if(optimism < 0.02) "Minimal (<0.02) — excellent generalisability"
             else if(optimism < 0.05) "Moderate (0.02–0.05) — acceptable generalisability"
             else "Substantial (>0.05) — evidence of overfitting"
  cat(sprintf("  Optimism interpretation: %s\n\n", interp))

  list(
    cv_mean    = cv_mean,
    cv_lower   = cv_lower,
    cv_upper   = cv_upper,
    cv_aucs    = cv_aucs,
    cv_lowers  = cv_lowers,
    cv_uppers  = cv_uppers,
    optimism   = optimism,
    interp     = interp
  )
}

pooled_A <- pool_cv(cv_results_A,
                    apparent_auc_A, apparent_lower_A, apparent_upper_A,
                    "MODEL A — Personality")

pooled_B <- pool_cv(cv_results_B,
                    apparent_auc_B, apparent_lower_B, apparent_upper_B,
                    "MODEL B — Full")

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: FOLD-LEVEL STABILITY
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: Fold-level stability\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

fold_stability <- function(cv_results_list, label) {
  fold_df <- tibble(
    Fold     = seq_len(n_folds),
    Mean_AUC = sapply(seq_len(n_folds), function(k)
      mean(sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$fold_aucs[k]))),
    SD_AUC   = sapply(seq_len(n_folds), function(k)
      sd(sapply(cv_results_list, function(x) x$fold_aucs[k])))
  )

  cat(sprintf("%s — fold AUC (averaged across imputations):\n", label))
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  print(fold_df, n = Inf)
  cat(sprintf("\n  Mean: %.3f  |  SD: %.3f  |  Range: %.3f – %.3f\n\n",
              mean(fold_df$Mean_AUC), sd(fold_df$Mean_AUC),
              min(fold_df$Mean_AUC), max(fold_df$Mean_AUC)))

  fold_df
}

fold_A <- fold_stability(cv_results_A, "MODEL A — Personality")
```
